source.name: 第一财经 中国市场

economy.zh:
过去24小时全球市场遭遇多重冲击，地缘冲突、AI监管与估值回调形成共振。美国空袭伊朗霍尔木兹海峡引发原油与美元飙升，欧洲股市承压；AI领域出现政策拐点——美国要求Anthropic和OpenAI限制模型出口，中国智谱AI借机缩小差距，Oracle因AI支出失控股价暴跌创2001年来最差周表现。中国A股和港股同步大跌，恒指触及一年新低，总市值单日蒸发约2.9万亿元，AI板块是本轮抛售核心。欧洲方面，欧元区通胀预期降温，但美伊紧张局势缓和迹象令衰退担忧减缓。值得关注的是，美联储压力测试显示大银行可抵御严重衰退，特朗普对欧洲关税威胁则埋下新贸易摩擦隐患。

- **地缘冲突升级**：美国在特朗普指责伊朗违反停火后空袭伊朗，霍尔木兹海峡局势骤紧，[布伦特原油与美元指数同步上涨](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQNElwZ0VuNFR1UVZQWlNSX2Q1OS1DVG9CandSbXFfakUzVzdvVUlVeWJ4Wkp3NkI4Q0dfMmtPVGx0Z3RhRDU2LWk0MlFwR0xxZ29MckFxZ3hzWEdwUjFmQlZCLVh3OUlDSWJaaFZwN3FIUkF2THZaS2JYMUV0ak45dDBXckN6OXNCUGdtOG1DaVk0M0dlTDV2c2lmcGlIWjVOQm4wVjRkYXYyTUNWSmpTZndvc1RuZ3MtRnp0U3QzOA)，欧洲股市下滑。[以色列与黎巴嫩达成框架协议](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/israel-lebanon-hezbollah-ceasefire-rubio.html)则为中东增添一丝缓和可能。
- **AI监管与出口管制**：美国政府以“国家安全”为由，要求[Anthropic](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-government-anthropic-claude-mythos5-ai.html)和[OpenAI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/openai-limits-new-ai-models-to-trusted-partners-request-us-government.html)将最新模型仅限“可信伙伴”使用，实质形成出口管控。与此同时，[中国智谱AI的GLM 5.2模型](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/china-zhipu-z-ai-open-source-anthropic-openai.html)在性价比上逼近美国前沿，开源模式成为新变量。
- **AI信仰松动**：[Oracle本周暴跌](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)，市值蒸发超千亿美元，市场开始质疑AI巨额投资的回报前景。[Jeremy Grantham警告](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/jeremy-grantham-says-this-is-the-most-expensive-market-in-american-history.html)当前美股为“美国历史上最贵”。
- **中国资产抛售**：A股与港股遭遇“黑色周五”，[恒生指数周跌幅创一年新高](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3358512/big-stride-xtep-opens-first-saucony-store-hong-kong-eyes-more-prime-retail-sites)，[阿里巴巴较历史高点腰斩](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNNGJ1TmU5OC1HZjIzUE5YQndWRDN2RFFtNndjOXlkQi1iVkFyLU02MkZhZVd0SVpobG1aX2VKR3l5ZHlnRktPZFoweVRMZFVuQTNnYkdGbmt3WDJYYlFiTFRNSUZLVGNrTEp5aVVrUU9GRUhCQkl3YzRfejlEN1plWlo5ZVRxOG1pd0NiVDh4VVVhWGZYczRkT25vU1hfMmJKNXE2alJNUGh1U2xjb090SmxSTU85WkRSVDRXcjJ3)。不过中国成功发行50亿欧元主权债，认购近5倍，表明国际资本对中国信用的认可。
- **欧洲经济分化**：欧元区消费者通胀预期下降，[5月ECB调查显示](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260626_1~60a21704a8.en.html)消费者对未来一年通胀预期回落，但[欧元区下滑速度放缓](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPeDl2QlZlMUtzSC1IbDR6X1dBa0Z4MEFDek5wb3drcUg5LTlwUkp0dHY1NDJta2FfOWI5ZXBBV1YydFlacjBjZE5Kc3BrLWgxUmpNWmZUbW84OHJjMFM5d1BlbUVGU3BjTTR1SFBfaGlWUVdCYkw4Z0tUbUZGZlBxbE5kWDVqUQ)。特朗普威胁对欧洲征100%关税，针对数字税，令贸易前景蒙阴。
- **美联储信号**：[美联储压力测试确认大银行韧性](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260624a.htm)，[特朗普对鲍威尔施压放缓](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/trump-warsh-fed-rate-cuts-inflation.html)，通胀突破4%后美联储获得“空间”。

**后续观察**：AI监管转向带来的地缘科技竞争可能重塑全球芯片及模型产业链；美伊冲突若持续，油价可能突破每桶90美元并加剧通胀，影响美联储降息路径；中国A股暴跌后的政策托底措施（如国家队进场）值得追踪；欧洲能否在数字税争端中与美达成妥协，将决定下一阶段贸易风险。
economy.en:
Global markets faced a volatile session as geopolitical tensions flared and AI-related stocks suffered sharp selloffs. The U.S. strikes on Iran after a ceasefire violation spiked oil prices, while AI export controls on Anthropic and OpenAI intensified concerns about supply chain disruptions and competitive dynamics. In China, the Hang Seng Index hit a one-year low amid a tech rout, and A-shares saw nearly 2.9 trillion yuan in market cap erased in a single day. Meanwhile, European markets slipped on rising oil and a cooling eurozone economy, though the ECB's latest survey showed consumers cutting inflation expectations. The week ahead features U.S. jobs data and an ECB inflation test that could set the tone for the next quarter.

- **Geopolitical shockwave:** The U.S. military struck Iran after President Trump accused Tehran of violating the Strait of Hormuz ceasefire, sending Brent crude and the dollar higher while European equities fell ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-strikes-iran-strait-of-hormuz-ceasefire.html), [equiti.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQNElwZ0VuNFR1UVZQWlNSX2Q1OS1DVG9CandSbXFfakUzVzdvVUlVeWJ4Wkp3NkI4Q0dfMmtPVGx0Z3RhRDU2LWk0MlFwR0xxZ29MckFxZ3hzWEdwUjFmQlZCLVh3OUlDSWJaaFZwN3FIUkF2THZaS2JYMUV0ak45dDBXckN6OXNCUGdtOG1DaVk0M0dlTDV2c2lmcGlIWjVOQm4wVjRkYXYyTUNWSmpTZndvc1RuZ3MtRnp0U3QzOA)).
- **AI export controls tighten:** The U.S. government directed Anthropic and OpenAI to restrict access to their latest AI models to 'trusted partners' only, hampering their commercial rollout and boosting open-source rival Zhipu's prospects ([CNBC 1](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-government-anthropic-claude-mythos5-ai.html), [CNBC 2](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/china-zhipu-z-ai-open-source-anthropic-openai.html), [CNBC 3](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/openai-limits-new-ai-models-to-trusted-partners-request-us-government.html)).
- **Oracle's worst week since dot-com bust:** Oracle shares tumbled as rising spending, negative free cash flow and $130 billion debt fueled AI financing fears—a bellwether for the broader AI capex cycle ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)).
- **China's AI ascent:** Zhipu's GLM 5.2 model is closing the gap with U.S. frontier models, underscoring a shift toward intelligence-per-dollar competition and the rising threat of open-source alternatives ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/china-zhipu-z-ai-open-source-anthropic-openai.html)).
- **European inflation expectations ease:** The ECB's May Consumer Expectations Survey showed consumers reduced their near-term inflation bets, supporting a more dovish ECB stance ahead of next week's policy meeting ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260626_1~60a21704a8.en.html), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQYUE2RmNmdFI4dS0tak52amItNEpfZWhsX0FEVC1jYWJJVDE3cy1EU3NSZEZySWFyXzhwT0Q3RTBCSnNtaW5DVmxfaGxDVGUxT2l4cWtud3hnSkppZERlcXpnS2tmSnFVdHRnUU1xUE5vN25nSi1WaWE0RzhKN0NpQnNKZURrX29qZ0hDcUN1UUtpNVYtQTJPU1JpeTZCZjRBSDlPcFppTC1sNDBRWkxZ)).
- **China and Hong Kong markets in turmoil:** The Hang Seng Index capped its worst week in over a year as AI selloffs deepened, and A-shares saw over 100 stocks double in less than two months before a sharp reversal erased ~2.9 trillion yuan in market cap ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/article/3358546/growth-agenda-hong-kong-vows-stronger-exchange-reforms-bond-futures-and-gold-push), [同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE16V0lXMF9YSU4wUWE3djZXNFRsNlJ4UUZUc2UydHMtaGNJVVphbGpYS0pmaUs4X01kNUFocUNSWFNnQzBwcWhOZ3lsV0RoRWJqNU9CRGNVOUV2RnpkOGgyTzFR)).
- **Trump escalates trade war rhetoric:** The U.S. president threatened 100% tariffs on European nations over digital services taxes, adding a new layer of uncertainty to transatlantic trade ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4rd71411ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).

**Watch next:** The upcoming week's U.S. nonfarm payrolls data and the ECB's inflation test will be critical in shaping rate expectations. Investors should also monitor the evolving AI regulatory landscape, as government restrictions could reshape competitive dynamics across the tech sector. The Iran conflict remains a wildcard for energy markets and risk appetite.

society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻在多条战线上剧烈震荡。美国对伊朗发动军事打击，使中东脆弱停火面临崩溃；委内瑞拉大地震已致920人死亡，国际救援队抵达但仍有数百人被困；欧洲遭遇致命热浪，德国录得41.3℃历史极值；前特朗普顾问博尔顿因不当处理机密文件认罪，面临最高5年监禁。与此同时，德克萨斯州将圣经故事列为学校必修课引发政教分离争议，刚果（金）近300名埃博拉确诊者下落不明，人道危机加剧。

- 【美伊冲突升级】美国中央司令部宣布打击伊朗导弹和无人机储存设施及海岸雷达，伊朗革命卫队随即宣布对美军区域发动报复。这是自6月17日谅解备忘录以来首次直接交火，市场动荡、油价急升。[US conducts strikes on Iran](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg590wqxwpo) / [Iran war live](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/27/iran-war-live-us-strikes-iran-after-fire-on-vessel-in-strait-of-hormuz)
- 【委内瑞拉地震浩劫】7.5级强震已确认920人遇难，数百人仍被埋废墟。一位母亲为救女儿牺牲的细节令全球动容。[Mother dies saving daughter](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0jydyz8z6jo) / [Venezuela earthquakes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39y79g7gzko)
- 【欧洲破纪录热浪】德国萨尔布吕肯录得41.3℃历史最高温，公共活动被迫取消，法国、意大利等国也发布红色预警。[Europe's deadly heatwave](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2knzzwprgo)
- 【博尔顿认罪】前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿同意支付225万美元罚款，面临最高5年监禁，标志性案件凸显美国政治人物安全违规的后果。[Ex-Trump adviser](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxqwg4nrvlo)
- 【德州圣经必修课】德克萨斯州要求公立学校将圣经故事纳入阅读必修内容，批评者指其侵犯宗教自由并模糊政教界线。[Religion row](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg8m2xkg84o)
- 【刚果埃博拉失联】非洲疾控中心称近300名埃博拉阳性者去向不明，冲突地区超过100万人生活在营地，模型预测9月前数千人死亡。[Whereabouts of nearly 300](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/jun/26/whereabouts-of-nearly-300-people-with-ebola-unknown-in-drc)
- 【以色列黎巴嫩框架协议】在美国斡旋下签署，但真主党未参与，此前停火多次遭跨境袭击打破。[Israel and Lebanon](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cg5315n1v5go)

**后续观察：** 美伊冲突可能颠覆中东能源安全格局，油价上行压力将传导至全球各国；委内瑞拉地震灾后防疫与救援时效是最大变量；欧洲热浪可能进一步推高能源需求，加剧区域紧张。
society.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by a sharp escalation in US-Iran hostilities, a catastrophic earthquake in Venezuela, and a record-breaking heatwave in Europe. These events underscore a volatile geopolitical and environmental landscape. Meanwhile, domestic news in China focuses on employment and education reforms, while a major operational blunder at Zhihu has sparked widespread discussion on social media. The following report highlights the most consequential developments across our desks.

- **US launches strikes on Iran** after an attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, testing a fragile June 17 ceasefire. The strikes targeted missile and drone storage facilities. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg590wqxwpo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/27/iran-war-live-us-strikes-iran-after-fire-on-vessel-in-strait-of-hormuz))
- **Venezuela earthquakes kill at least 920 people**, with hundreds still trapped. Rescue teams are arriving internationally, and stories of personal tragedy, such as a mother dying to save her daughter, highlight the human toll. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39y79g7gzko), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0jydyz8z6jo))
- **Europe's heatwave breaks German records**, with a provisional 41.3°C in Saarbrücken. Public events are being halted and the extreme temperatures pose health risks, particularly for vulnerable populations. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2knzzwprgo))
- **Former Trump adviser John Bolton pleads guilty** to mishandling classified documents, facing up to five years in prison and a $2.25m fine. This adds to the ongoing legal scrutiny of former administration officials. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxqwg4nrvlo))
- **Texas mandates Bible stories in school reading**, igniting a religion row over separation of church and state. Critics argue it infringes on religious freedoms. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg8m2xkg84o))
- **Ukraine and Russia continue heavy drone bombardments** against each other, with Ukraine striking a dozen Russian regions and Crimea, while Russia attacks multiple Ukrainian regions. The war shows no sign of de-escalation. ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/06/26/nx-s1-5872256/russia-ukraine-war-drone-strikes))
- **DR Congo Ebola outbreak grows more dangerous** as nearly 300 confirmed cases are untraceable, raising fears of widespread community transmission. The conflict-driven humanitarian crisis complicates containment efforts. ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development/2026/jun/26/whereabouts-of-nearly-300-people-with-ebola-unknown-in-drc))
- **Zhihu ex-employee accidentally sends 3 million RMB as 'points'** to users, causing account freezes and a social media firestorm. This operational failure highlights internal control weaknesses at the Q&A platform. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FSnVGbE12bEp5eWJGdldyNldXb25jTUNzQnByakpiMmNvUzhHNzB5aDRGNDRRbXgzckRFN05CYV9pOTE3WGFraXFDaWFDZkJPVkRKS2NVbDVaOFJkTE9MdDIzOA))

**Watch next:** The US-Iran conflict is likely to escalate further, with Iran's IRGC already retaliating against US forces. The Venezuela earthquake aftermath will continue to unfold, with rescue operations and potential disease outbreaks. The European heatwave may intensify, affecting agriculture and energy demand. Domestically, the Zhihu incident may lead to regulatory scrutiny and internal reforms at tech companies.

military.zh:
过去24小时，全球军事安全格局出现多重重大变动：美伊短暂停火协议迅速破裂，美国对伊朗境内目标实施打击；中东能源安全焦虑推动煤炭等化石燃料意外回归；俄乌冲突外溢效应持续，克里米亚宣布紧急状态；大国博弈在印太与欧洲同步升温，新西兰释放中国军事活动常态化信号，美国陆军成立新太平洋司令部。以下为关键动态：

- **美伊冲突再起**：美国中央司令部证实，美军于6月26日打击伊朗导弹、无人机和雷达站点，以回应前一天伊朗袭击霍尔木兹海峡商船的行动。这是自6月24日双方签署和平备忘录以来的首次直接军事打击，停火框架实质性动摇。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed)、[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)

- **中东能源安全逆转**：国际能源署（IEA）报告指出，对伊朗战争担忧正使能源投资重心从气候转向电力安全，煤炭重新成为备用选项。英国汽油价格因美伊协议短期波动，但市场对后续冲突升级保持警惕。[IntelliNews](https://news.google.)、[BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE9vN0tpNVdZWWNRUC1TdVFmZE1FNWpURGFiUlVQYU9ENW92U1k0U0tCMnVXcjdSd2xHRUV2bTFZMnVfM3pQWEFqNDdDalBIakJMOF80dXlVVTlRdw)

- **俄乌冲突战线**：被俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚宣布进入紧急状态并关闭海滩季节，显示乌克兰远程打击对俄控制区域造成的持续压力。[Le Monde.fr](https://news.google.)

- **以色列-黎巴嫩历史性突破**：在美国斡旋下，以色列和黎巴嫩签署框架协议，被双方称为“迈向和平的第一步”。国务卿鲁比奥出席，此举可能重塑中东安全格局。[Spectrum News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNOUlfbndDdUFkVkxGY253Qm5ON0h5OVExS1NWV05TTmRYOFZaeF9TdXZLZng4MVlOZl9KN1FNbjFqZWNsT2x2OVFiN3VyQkVRYWREVzFobVNrWFh6NW9EamhvekVjN0E1cHppZXV1UFVEXzlkRE5seVpXQ2dEeEdra2ppbnZ2Ny1RNTJ6OFpMS3FYU0lSR2NRUWw2Qy1peDFCd3c)

- **印太博弈加码**：美国陆军正式建立新的太平洋司令部以应对中国反介入/区域拒止（A2/AD）网络；同时RIMPAC 2026在夏威夷启动，30国30余艘舰艇参演。新西兰内部文件警告中国在太平洋军事活动“常态化”。[Zona Militar](https://news.google.)、[dw.com](https://news.google.)

- **军备与技术动态**：F-35正式以无雷达状态交付；韩国计划训练50万人操作无人机；乌克兰推出新型大型水下无人潜航器“Sea Trident ST-1000”；法国海军再次扣押俄罗斯影子舰队油轮。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/its-official-f-35s-are-now-being-delivered-without-radars)、[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/)、[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的快速升级表明中东停火机制的脆弱性，未来数日需关注伊朗是否会进一步报复以及霍尔木兹海峡航运安全。以色列-黎巴嫩协议若能落实，将显著改变黎巴嫩真主党与以色列的对峙态势。中国在太平洋地区的军事活动持续引发邻国警惕，新西兰的公开警告或导致更多太平洋岛国加强安全合作。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a dramatic escalation in the US-Iran conflict despite a recently signed peace memorandum, with US forces striking Iranian missile, drone, and radar sites after an attack on a commercial vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Simultaneously, a landmark US-brokered framework agreement between Israel and Lebanon offers a potential diplomatic breakthrough in the Middle East. In the Indo-Pacific, RIMPAC 2026 begins with 30 nations, while China's military activities in the Pacific draw warnings from New Zealand. Ukraine unveils a massive new underwater drone, and South Korea plans to train half a million troops for drone warfare—underscoring the accelerating global shift toward unmanned systems. Defense budgets are rising, with the House appropriators approving a $1.1 trillion Pentagon funding bill that even renames the Department of War.

- **US-Iran Ceasefire Collapses?** The US launched its first strike on Iran since the peace memorandum, targeting missile, drone, and radar sites in retaliation for an Iranian attack on a cargo vessel exiting the Strait of Hormuz ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)). The strikes threaten to unravel the fragile ceasefire and have already spiked energy security fears, with coal making an unexpected comeback ([IntelliNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxPT1VKM1M4YUNRN1JSZl9WdTJuU2FYZjlpYzJFaGhocWxiai1McnpuR1FnbzJYOUFZb3RyWkZwNzdDTEl4NEI5STYzV0ZpZmFwVzVKNGlpTno0LTlfWU8tS1pkemY2MHFjUVhrd2VTX0wzVnFCZGNfMVVjR2F5dTI0TFRNeFh5RGNKYXJ0MHNQZjJYblZqUDZONUFiOTBZQ1hUMGVGRGJyUEt2RFgy)).

- **Israel-Lebanon Breakthrough:** Israel and Lebanon signed a US-brokered framework agreement, with Secretary Rubio calling it a "first step" toward peace ([Spectrum News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNOUlfbndDdUFkVkxGY253Qm5ON0h5OVExS1NWV05TTmRYOFZaeF9TdXZLZng4MVlOZl9KN1FNbjFqZWNsT2x2OVFiN3VyQkVRYWREVzFobVNrWFh6NW9EamhvekVjN0E1cHppZXV1UFVEXzlkRE5seVpXQ2dEeEdra2ppbnZ2Ny1RNTJ6OFpMS3FYU0lSR2NRUWw2Qy1peDFCd3c)). This could reshape regional dynamics, though implementation remains uncertain.

- **Ukraine's Sea Trident ST-1000:** Ukraine unveiled its first extra-large uncrewed underwater vehicle (XLUUV) at Eurosatory 2026, a steel-hulled strike drone capable of heavy-duty missions ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/)). This marks a significant expansion of Ukraine's asymmetric naval capabilities.

- **RIMPAC 2026 Underway:** The world's largest maritime exercise began in Hawaii with 30 nations and over 30 warships, signaling continued multinational cooperation in the Pacific ([Marine Insight](https://news.google.)).

- **South Korea’s Drone Army:** South Korea plans to train 500,000 troops to operate drones, reflecting a major investment in unmanned warfare ([Militarnyi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPYzVtTURhVE8wMGs0SlVYYmRVb0pHUVhpNGFmeEZCNkZWVjlxdk9sYVBvSEMyeUFjOGJhdm41MVRGUVp3bktGSUEwc3RrN0xqbWE2NndMdFF0QzgzWnQ5Z3hyNHdlS2pMSHBaUVFsU2Z1Tnd6MC1hLW1KWkhIeHprVEh4VVdjQkJSd01obWNzYmpNU3BZZXc)).

- **China's Pacific 'Normalization' Warning:** New Zealand internal documents warn that China's military activities in the Pacific are becoming "normalized," raising concerns about regional stability ([RFI](https://news.google.)).

- **French Seize Fifth Russian Shadow Fleet Tanker:** The French Navy intercepted tanker MT Deliver off Sicily, part of ongoing efforts to crack down on sanctions evasion ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)).

**Watch next:** The US-Iran situation remains highly volatile—any further tit-for-tat strikes could trigger a broader conflict in the Gulf, with immediate consequences for global energy markets. The Israel-Lebanon deal will be scrutinized for follow-through, while RIMPAC and Chinese Pacific activities will set the tone for Indo-Pacific security in the coming weeks.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块的重心在三个维度上展开：一是亚马逊Prime Day进入最后冲刺，科技产品折扣覆盖苹果、扫地机器人、智能灯具等品类，但读者需留意库存与时间窗口；二是AI领域地缘博弈加剧，美国特朗普政府有条件解禁Anthropic的Mythos 5模型，但同时OpenAI和Anthropi被曝限制新模型仅向特朗普批准的客户提供，中国用户则持续绕过Anthropic的地理限制，形成「管制-规避」的对抗链条；三是汽车市场特斯拉Q2交付共识仅微增、Jeep Recon EV续航不及预期、Slate电动皮卡以2.5万美元起售价冲击市场，新能源竞争进入「价格与续航」的硬碰硬阶段。HackNews社区则围绕EFF对加州3D打印机监控计划的警示、Om Malik逝世悼念、以及「vibe coding」争议（Corgi被指控窃取开源项目）展开热议。

- [Prime Day最后一天：苹果Watch Series 11史低价、AirPods Pro 3售179美元](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/949350/amazon-prime-day-sale-best-apple-deals-2026) — The Verge
- [OpenAI挖来Uber印度主管负责其美国以外最大市场，印度战略加速](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/openai-poaches-uber-india-chief-to-lead-its-biggest-market-outside-the-u-s/) — TechCrunch
- [特朗普政府批准Anthropic向逾100家美国企业与机构重新部署Mythos 5](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/trump-admin-releases-anthropic-mythos-to-be-used-by-more-than-100-us-companies-agencies/) — TechCrunch
- [特斯拉FSD致死案达成和解，联邦调查仍在继续](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/tesla-settles-fsd-crash-lawsuit-as-federal-investigations-continue/) — TechCrunch
- [Slate电动皮卡起售价24,950美元，部分地区可低于20,000美元](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/slate-truck-under-20000-state-incentives/) — Electrek
- [EFF呼吁阻止加州3D打印机监控计划](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/we-can-still-stop-californias-3d-printer-surveillance-scheme) — EFF（Hacker News 299点）

**后续观察**：特朗普政府对AI模型的「批准制」可能成为新常态，将技术出口限制从硬件延伸至模型权重本身，这一范式转变值得所有跨境AI服务商警惕。同时，特斯拉FSD和解案未能消除联邦调查阴影，Q2交付若低于预期可能引发新一轮股价波动。电子消费品方面，Prime Day后价格将回归，建议消费者抓住最后机会。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by the final hours of Amazon Prime Day, a major geopolitical shift in AI model deployment, and significant developments in the electric vehicle market. The Trump administration partially lifted Anthropic's export ban, allowing Mythos 5 to a select group of US organizations, while OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 and revealed its custom chip 'Jalapeño'. In EVs, Slate Auto's $25,000 electric truck, Tesla's Q2 delivery outlook, and BYD's pickup redesign are key stories. The community is also discussing the ethics of AI in mathematics and a proposed 3D printer surveillance scheme in California.

- **Prime Day finale** brings deep discounts on Apple products, Philips Hue smart lights, robot vacuums, and more, with many deals expiring today ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/949350/amazon-prime-day-sale-best-apple-deals-2026), [Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/best-prime-day-apple-deals-06-26-2026/)).
- **Anthropic's Mythos 5** is back for over 100 US companies and agencies after weeks of negotiation with the Trump administration, but the public-facing Fable 5 remains restricted ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/trump-admin-releases-anthropic-mythos-to-be-used-by-more-than-100-us-companies-agencies/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/958458/anthropic-mythos-5-is-back-trump-negotiations)).
- **OpenAI's chip ambitions** intensify: the company is building 'Jalapeño' with Broadcom, joining a wave of firms reducing dependency on Nvidia ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/video/why-everyone-from-openai-to-spacex-is-building-their-own-chips-and-turning-up-the-heat-on-nvidia/)).
- **Tesla Q2 delivery consensus** of 406,024 vehicles signals modest 5.7% growth amid federal investigations into FSD crashes ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/tesla-q2-2026-delivery-consensus-406000/)).
- **Slate Auto's $25,000 electric truck** could drop below $20,000 with state incentives, threatening legacy pickups like the Toyota Hilux EV ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/slate-truck-under-20000-state-incentives/)).
- **South Korea plans** to train its entire half-million-strong military as 'drone warriors', treating UAVs as a universal combat tool ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/06/south-korea-plans-to-train-entire-military-as-drone-warriors/)).
- **AI in mathematics** is forcing foundational questions, while the gap between open-weights and closed-source LLMs remains a hot debate ([IEEE Spectrum](https://spectrum.ieee.org/ai-in-mathematics), [blog.doubleword.ai](https://blog.doubleword.ai/frontier-os-llm)).
- **California's 3D printer surveillance scheme** faces a last-minute opposition from EFF, with over 300 points on Hacker News ([EFF](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/we-can-still-stop-californias-3d-printer-surveillance-scheme)).

**Watch next:** Prime Day deals will vanish by midnight; check the final roundups before they expire. The Mythos 5 deployment will set a precedent for AI export controls under the current administration. Tesla's Q2 delivery numbers (due early July) and the progress of OpenAI's custom chip will shape the AI hardware landscape. In EVs, watch for Slate's expansion plans and BYD's pickup redesign for the domestic market.

sports.zh:
## 体育新闻日报 2026-06-27

世界杯小组赛收官日爆出多场冷门：**乌拉圭**门将穆斯莱拉的超级失误直接导致球队1-0负于西班牙，以小组第三耻辱出局；首次参赛的**佛得角**则凭借三场平局奇迹般晋级32强，将迎战阿根廷。与此同时，NBA自由市场正式开启，多笔续约与交易落地——雷霆3年7500万锁定哈滕施泰因，拉梅洛·鲍尔被送至森林狼，联盟格局悄然生变。以下是各子板块详细解读。

- **乌拉圭耻辱出局，西班牙也付出代价**：穆斯莱拉半场被换下，赛后BBC直指“灾难性失误”导致乌拉圭自2002年以来首次小组赛出局，主帅贝尔萨的“有毒”执教风格再次被拷问。西班牙虽以头名晋级，但边锋耶雷米·皮诺可能因伤告别世界杯，尼科·威廉姆斯也在伤疑名单中。
- **佛得角奇迹与“算计”失败**：佛得角0-0逼平沙特，以小组第三名身份出线，将在1/16决赛对阵阿根廷。BBC称这是“525万人口的童话”。另一边，奥地利和阿尔及利亚表示不会为了避开西班牙而故意输球，但实际结果将影响淘汰赛对阵。
- **梅西替补，哈兰德休息**：阿根廷主帅斯卡洛尼确认梅西将在对阵约旦的末轮小组赛替补待命，以保全体能；挪威则在已出线情况下轮换10人，0-3负于法国，主帅索尔巴肯称这是“无需思考的决定”。
- **NBA自由市场开闸，中锋成抢手货**：雷霆中锋哈滕施泰因3年7500万留队，太阳中锋马克·威廉姆斯3年3800万回归，尼克斯则用3年1400万留住阿尔瓦拉多。最大交易来自黄蜂：拉梅洛·鲍尔和约什·格林被送至森林狼，换回纳兹·里德及选秀权，狼队后场深度骤增。
- **选秀后续与夏季联赛看点**：状元AJ·迪班萨因球衣号码问题引发话题，公牛新秀凯莱布·威尔逊豪言争夺最佳新秀。NBA公布夏季联赛赛程，热火vs雄鹿将上演“字母哥交易后”的首次对决。

**后续观察**：世界杯淘汰赛对阵即将出炉，阿根廷vs佛得角、西班牙可能的对手值得关注；NBA自由市场仍在发酵，湖人、勇士等队尚未有大动作，接下来几天将是签约高峰。
sports.en:
The sports world is dominated by World Cup group-stage drama and a flurry of NBA offseason moves. Uruguay's shocking elimination, Cape Verde's fairytale qualification, and Spain's injury concerns headline the football action, while the NBA sees major trades and free-agent signings reshape the league. The Chinese fan community on Hupu buzzes with reactions to these stories, and badminton offers minimal news ahead of the BWF World Championships.

- **Uruguay Crumbles: Bielsa's Reign Ends in Disgrace** – A first-half blunder by goalkeeper Fernando Muslera gifted Spain a 1-0 win, sending Uruguay crashing out of the World Cup in the group stage. The defeat ends Marcelo Bielsa's tumultuous tenure, with BBC Sport labeling it a 'toxic' conclusion. [Uruguay yank keeper at HT after howler vs. Spain](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49192407/uruguay-yank-keeper-muslera-howler-spain) | ['I leave nothing' - the end of 'toxic' Bielsa's Uruguay reign](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce95d89x5meo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Cape Verde’s Miracle Continues** – The island nation of just 525,000 people secured a draw against Saudi Arabia to advance to the last 32 in their debut World Cup, setting up a potential clash with Argentina. The emotional scenes underscore one of the tournament's greatest underdog stories. [How Cape Verde stunned World Cup to set up Argentina tie](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0mypzl7v2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) | ['The fairytale continues!' Emotional scenes as Cape Verde qualify for last 32](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cx2d8gvdlr0o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Spain Wins Group but Faces Injury Scare** – Spain topped Group H via a 1-0 win over Uruguay, but wingers Nico Williams and Yéremy Pino are injury doubts for the knockout stage. [Spain win group but could lose Pino for rest of WC...](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49193963/spain-2026-world-cup-injury-yeremy-pino-nico-williams)
- **Knockout Permutations & Key Decisions** – Norway rested Erling Haaland and 10 others against France (a heavy loss) while Argentina will bench Lionel Messi for their final group game against Jordan. England’s knockout place is already confirmed before facing Panama. [Norway coach: No Haaland vs. France a 'no-brainer'](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49190980/norway-stale-solbakken-world-cup-erling-haaland-benched-no-brainer) | [Messi to start on bench for Argentina group finale](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49191791/lionel-messi-argentina-bench-jordan-fifa-2026-world-cup) | [England qualify for World Cup knockout stage](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c1wylljn12xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **NBA Offseason Frenzy: Blockbuster LaMelo Ball Trade, Key Free-Agent Signings** – The Hornets sent LaMelo Ball and Josh Green to the Timberwolves for Naz Reid and picks. Isaiah Hartenstein stays with OKC on a 3-year, $75M deal, Mark Williams returns to the Suns for $38M over three years, and José Alvarado re-signs with the Knicks. The Thunder also traded Isaiah Joe to Detroit for second-round picks. - **Hupu Community Reacts to World Cup & NBA** – Chinese fans celebrate Senegal’s record 5-0 win, debate Japan’s group-stage odds, and share memes about France’s expensive forward line. The community also tracks NBA draft prospects and player birthdays.
