entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块多头并进：欧美圈迎来《The Bear》系列大结局的温情致敬、Harvey Weinstein上诉案出现戏剧性转折，以及Bill Maher与副总统JD Vance的政论碰撞引发热议；日韩方面BTS稳坐品牌声誉榜首，但《爱丽丝梦游边境》演员涉暴力丑闻为K-pop蒙上阴影；中国影视圈白玉兰奖尘埃落定，85花演技获评蜕变，而韩红催票翻车事件则折射行业寒冬；微博社区因杨幂搀扶孙俪杨紫的礼仪瞬间、辛芷蕾回乡撸串的烟火气以及《藏海传》颗粒无收的质疑声持续沸腾。

- **[《The Bear》系列大结局致敬Rob Reiner](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/the-bear-series-finale-rob-reiner-tribute-1235585395/)**：这部备受关注的餐厅剧集在最终集中以细腻方式纪念已故演员Rob Reiner（他饰演了餐厅顾问Albert），成为全季情感高光点。
- **[Harvey Weinstein洛杉矶上诉被驳回但获重新量刑](https://deadline.com/2026/06/harvey-weinstein-conviction-upheld-l-a-1236968805/)**：在纽约案出现“部分无罪”后的次日，加州上诉法院维持其2022年性侵定罪，但以程序问题为由撤销原判，发回重判。检察官拟求刑20年，标志着#MeToo司法进程的复杂推进。
- **[JD Vance做客Bill Maher节目，Maher坦言可能投共和党](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bill-maher-played-by-jd-vance-real-time-hbo-may-vote-republican-2028-1236795870/)**：副总统在美伊冲突升级的背景下按原计划接受采访，Maher事后承认被对方“套路”，并透露2028年或转投共和党，引发自由派观众哗然。
- **[Luca Guadagnino谈《Artificial》发行困境与AI威胁](https://deadline.com/2026/06/luca-guadagnino-gives-hope-artificial-release-1236968824/)**：在Amazon MGM放弃发行后，导演暗示该片可能另寻出路，同时警告AI正“彻底改变世界身份”，其担忧比“令人不安”更甚。
- **[BTS蝉联6月歌手品牌声誉榜首](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850646wpp/june-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)**：韩国企业评价研究所数据显示，BTS凭借无可撼动的媒体指数与粉丝参与度继续领跑，巩固了K-pop金字招牌地位。
- **[第31届白玉兰奖揭晓，85花被评“演技蜕变”](https://news.google.)**：新浪娱乐评论指出，这届获奖名单背后是中生代女演员从流量向实力的集体转向，行业评价体系正在重塑。
- **[杨幂搀扶孙俪杨紫登台引爆全网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE42cXJtNkxFUldSdzRjRUZrRE1JZjRyM3NwS2ppZldvYnYtZVljVHYxaHg1Q0tpWEZoUW43dnpJdV8tVkJMQ2NRUjg0QjNaRGdmb0FKMnFSMnNNRmktSE5Hb1BhQnprczAxTklEbDUxSnJoZw)**：白玉兰晚宴上这一细节被赞“教科书级礼仪”，折射出圈内人际关系的微妙信号，成为微博当日最高赞话题之一。

**后续观察**：美国最高法院是否受理Catherine Herridge的请愿将影响记者保护判例；《The Bear》大结局口碑可能为艾美奖布局预热；韩红翻车事件若持续发酵，或将加速国内综艺赞助模式调整；白玉兰奖后85花的片约与代言变化值得追踪。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape this week is dominated by high-stakes legal battles, nostalgic sequels, and award-season drama. Harvey Weinstein’s LA appeal failed but a resentencing was ordered, while Catherine Herridge takes her fight over source protection to the Supreme Court. In TV, *The Bear* concluded with a touching tribute to Rob Reiner, and Larry David’s indefinite presence in comedy was reaffirmed. K-pop continues its global march with BTS topping brand rankings and LE SSERAFIM returning to BlizzCon, while China’s entertainment industry navigates a post-idol-show reckoning and the 31st Bai Yu Lan Awards highlighted performance evolution. Social media buzzed over star-studded banquets and celebrity endorsements of Lionel Messi.

- **Harvey Weinstein’s tangled legal saga**: A California appeals court upheld his 2022 sexual assault conviction but vacated the sentence, ordering resentencing ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/harvey-weinstein-conviction-upheld-l-a-1236968805/), [THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/appeals-court-harvey-weinstein-resentencing-conviction-stands-1236632009/)). This comes a day after a mistrial was declared in his New York case — a mixed outcome that keeps him behind bars but adds years of uncertainty for victims and the industry.
- **Bill Maher’s surprising swing**: Vice President JD Vance appeared on *Real Time* despite US-Iran tensions, leading Maher to admit he “may vote Republican in 2028” ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bill-maher-played-by-jd-vance-real-time-hbo-may-vote-republican-2028-1236795870/)). The interview highlights the blurring line between entertainment and political discourse.
- **Madonna’s Glastonbury hint**: In her Graham Norton interview, Madonna revealed jealousy of Kylie Minogue and strongly hinted at a Glastonbury performance ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn07rpn0rkxo)). The Queen of Pop’s next move could define the summer music festival season.
- **Romy & Michele are back**: Mira Sorvino announced the first day of filming for the sequel to *Romy and Michele’s High School Reunion*, 29 years later ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/mira-sorvino-marks-first-day-romy-michele-sequel-filming-1236968848/)). Nostalgia-driven reboots continue to draw audience attention.
- **Tom Sandoval escalates conflict**: New video allegedly shows the *Vanderpump Rules* star pushing his ex-girlfriend’s father into a fire pit ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/vanderpump-rules-tom-sandoval-ex-girlfriend-dad-video-1236632040/)). Reality TV’s messy boundaries raise questions about accountability and content standards.
- **AI anxiety in Hollywood**: Luca Guadagnino expressed worry about AI “changing the identity of the world” after Amazon dropped his film *Artificial* about OpenAI’s Sam Altman ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/luca-guadagnino-ai-amazon-artificial-1236795673/), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/luca-guadagnino-gives-hope-artificial-release-1236968824/)). The situation underscores the industry’s uneasy relationship with technology.
- **China’s Bai Yu Lan Awards signal shift**: The 31st Bai Yu Lan Awards saw a focus on “85花” actresses’ evolving acting skills, with discussions on industry reform ([Sina via Google News](https://news.google.)). This reflects broader attempts to professionalize and de-inflate bubble fandom.
- **K-pop global expansion continues**: LE SSERAFIM will perform at BlizzCon for the first time in three years ([China Entertainment News via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE00eE1JMEdwWGV3ZzdIZzlrUGpmTi1BR3p4OVZ0VjEwbjRkcWI0aVdKcHU0MkhKUmtmLWpibWRKcGQ2RVBDT183MDdqMGFQWDQxZEF2UG9sVDFheG8)). Meanwhile, BTS maintained the top spot in June singer brand reputation ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850646wpp/june-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)).

**Watch next**: The fallout from the Weinstein resentencing and the premiere of *Romy & Michele* sequel will be closely tracked. Madonna’s possible Glastonbury performance and the *Artificial* distribution battle could reshape the summer entertainment calendar. In Asia, the idol school variety show *IDOL SCHOOL CAMP* and the continued legal case of the *Alice in Borderland* actor will drive conversation on social platforms.

美股.zh:
美股本周在AI信仰松动和地缘冲突双重打击下持续走弱，Oracle单周跌幅创2001年来之最，AI巨额资本开支开始引发投资者担忧。同时美国政府出手限制AI模型出口，凸显国家安全优先于商业扩张的思路。

- **[美国空袭伊朗](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-strikes-iran-strait-of-hormuz-ceasefire.html)**：特朗普指责伊朗违反停火，发动军事打击，霍尔木兹海峡油轮通行风险陡增，原油与美元同步走强。
- **[Oracle暴跌](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)**：负债1300亿美元、自由现金流为负，市场对AI投资回报的耐心耗尽。
- **[AI出口管制](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-government-anthropic-claude-mythos5-ai.html)**：Anthropic、OpenAI被要求限制模型访问，预示美国科技出口将更严格审查。
- **[Jeremy Grantham警告](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/jeremy-grantham-says-this-is-the-most-expensive-market-in-american-history.html)**：当前美股估值“史上最贵”，AI泡沫风险被反复提及。
- **[特朗普对欧关税](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4rd71411ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)**：威胁对欧洲数字服务税征收100%关税，可能触发新一轮贸易争端。

**收束**：AI叙事从“无限乐观”转入“回报验证”阶段，叠加地缘风险，短期美股波动率将维持高位，关注下周ISM制造业数据及英伟达等AI龙头财报前瞻。
美股.en:
U.S. equities faced a turbulent session as AI-related stocks plunged on financing and regulatory worries, while geopolitical risk from U.S.-Iran strikes added pressure. The market is bracing for a key week of jobs data and Fed commentary. Investors are reassessing the sustainability of AI spending after Oracle's worst week since 2001, and veteran bear Jeremy Grantham calls the market the most expensive in American history.

- **Oracle's debt-driven selloff:** Oracle's stock ended its worst week since the dot-com bust, with $130 billion in debt and negative free cash flow alarming investors about the AI capex cycle ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/oracle-stock-ends-worst-week-since-2001-as-investors-dwell-on-finances.html)).
- **AI model restrictions hit U.S. leaders:** The U.S. government forced Anthropic and OpenAI to limit new AI model releases to 'trusted partners,' complicating their revenue growth and competitive positioning ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/openai-limits-new-ai-models-to-trusted-partners-request-us-government.html), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-government-anthropic-claude-mythos5-ai.html)).
- **Geopolitical flashpoint:** U.S. strikes on Iran after a ceasefire violation drove oil prices higher and dampened risk sentiment, with the VIX likely spiking ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/us-strikes-iran-strait-of-hormuz-ceasefire.html)).
- **Fed stress test passes, but Warsh under pressure:** The Fed's annual bank stress test confirmed large banks' resilience, but Chairman Warsh faces market calls for rate cuts amid inflation above 4% and Trump's renewed pressure ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260624a.htm), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/trump-warsh-fed-rate-cuts-inflation.html)).
- **Grantham's warning:** Jeremy Grantham warns this is the most expensive market in 'American history,' driven by AI euphoria ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/jeremy-grantham-says-this-is-the-most-expensive-market-in-american-history.html)).

**Signal:** The AI trade is being tested on two fronts—regulatory constraints and balance sheet risk—while geopolitical turmoil adds a fresh headwind. Watch for a rotation out of tech cyclicals into defensive or energy stocks.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲市场在美伊冲突和贸易威胁中承压，但欧元区自身数据出现改善迹象：消费者通胀预期下降，经济下滑速度放缓。以色列与黎巴嫩停火框架给中东带来一丝稳定，但欧洲对美关税反击风险上升。

- **[ECB消费者调查](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260626_1~60a21704a8.en.html)**：5月数据显示消费者对未来一年通胀预期降至较低水平，缓解欧央行继续加息压力。
- **[欧元区放缓减速](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPeDl2QlZlMUtzSC1IbDR6X1dBa0Z4MEFDek5wb3drcUg5LTlwUkp0dHY1NDJta2FfOWI5ZXBBV1YydFlacjBjZE5Kc3BrLWgxUmpNWmZUbW84OHJjMFM5d1BlbUVGU3BjTTR1SFBfaGlWUVdCYkw4Z0tUbUZGZlBxbE5kWDVqUQ)**：美伊紧张局势缓和帮助商业信心边际改善，但整体仍处于收缩边缘。
- **[以色列-黎巴嫩框架协议](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/26/israel-lebanon-hezbollah-ceasefire-rubio.html)**：若真主党接受，中东局势可能出现重大转折，利好欧洲能源供应稳定。
- **[特朗普关税威胁](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cn4rd71411ko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)**：100%关税恐冲击欧洲数字企业（如亚马逊、谷歌的欧洲业务），欧股汽车和奢侈品板块均面临连锁风险。
- **[欧洲股市走低](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQNElwZ0VuNFR1UVZQWlNSX2Q1OS1DVG9CandSbXFfakUzVzdvVUlVeWJ4Wkp3NkI4Q0dfMmtPVGx0Z3RhRDU2LWk0MlFwR0xxZ29MckFxZ3hzWEdwUjFmQlZCLVh3OUlDSWJaaFZwN3FIUkF2THZaS2JYMUV0ak45dDBXckN6OXNCUGdtOG1DaVk0M0dlTDV2c2lmcGlIWjVOQm4wVjRkYXYyTUNWSmpTZndvc1RuZ3MtRnp0U3QzOA)**：布伦特原油升破84美元，美元指数走高，欧洲进口成本压力增大。

**收束**：欧洲经济处于“通胀降温但增长乏力”的微妙窗口，ECB后续政策将更多取决于油价演变和美国关税博弈，而非单纯的通胀读数。
欧洲经济.en:
European equities edged lower as Brent crude advanced on U.S.-Iran tensions, while the eurozone downturn showed signs of slowing. The ECB's Consumer Expectations Survey revealed a drop in near-term inflation bets, signaling that consumers expect price pressures to ease. Investors are now looking ahead to the ECB's upcoming inflation test and U.S. jobs data for directional cues.

- **ECB survey lower inflation expectations:** Euro zone consumers cut their inflation expectations for the next year, according to the ECB's May survey—a supportive sign for a dovish ECB stance ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260626_1~60a21704a8.en.html), [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxQYUE2RmNmdFI4dS0tak52amItNEpfZWhsX0FEVC1jYWJJVDE3cy1EU3NSZEZySWFyXzhwT0Q3RTBCSnNtaW5DVmxfaGxDVGUxT2l4cWtud3hnSkppZERlcXpnS2tmSnFVdHRnUU1xUE5vN25nSi1WaWE0RzhKN0NpQnNKZURrX29qZ0hDcUN1UUtpNVYtQTJPU1JpeTZCZjRBSDlPcFppTC1sNDBRWkxZ)).
- **Eurozone downturn slows:** The region's economic contraction moderated as U.S.-Iran tensions cooled, but the recovery remains fragile ([Euractiv](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPeDl2QlZlMUtzSC1IbDR6X1dBa0Z4MEFDek5wb3drcUg5LTlwUkp0dHY1NDJta2FfOWI5ZXBBV1YydFlacjBjZE5Kc3BrLWgxUmpNWmZUbW84OHJjMFM5d1BlbUVGU3BjTTR1SFBfaGlWUVdCYkw4Z0tUbUZGZlBxbE5kWDVqUQ)).
- **Geopolitical risk lifts oil:** Brent crude advanced alongside the DXY as the U.S. struck Iran, creating a stagflationary risk for European importers ([equiti.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivwFBVV95cUxQNElwZ0VuNFR1UVZQWlNSX2Q1OS1DVG9CandSbXFfakUzVzdvVUlVeWJ4Wkp3NkI4Q0dfMmtPVGx0Z3RhRDU2LWk0MlFwR0xxZ29MckFxZ3hzWEdwUjFmQlZCLVh3OUlDSWJaaFZwN3FIUkF2THZaS2JYMUV0ak45dDBXckN6OXNCUGdtOG1DaVk0M0dlTDV2c2lmcGlIWjVOQm4wVjRkYXYyTUNWSmpTZndvc1RuZ3MtRnp0U3QzOA)).
- **Dividend outlook for July:** Morningstar highlighted European stocks paying dividends in July, offering income seekers a potential buffer amid equity volatility ([Morningstar](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikwFBVV95cUxQY0psd3lMOVF6a213QV8tV3I4NkJvRTh6NWV6ek9MeHg0WVh3TTZUT25KSG9QdFc1cVNLaThrR0w0N0JfbkNfNGdOUjhqNG5HUUdfRFZ0ZGdvZGR0N0IySHFRNHhJU1M4a2FZM1Mtc1p4NXd5Uzl1eHdNWEhnbHcyQWtiRHBRdDl6d1ptcVpIeGpiUlk)).
- **Long-term investment product push:** The Jacques Delors Centre proposes a long-term investment product for EU citizens to channel retail savings into capital markets, which could deepen European equity participation ([Jacques Delors Centre](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimwFBVV95cUxPdmdCSUJhQzlSN3VUOUgyUGdjSU9ZY1E0Yk42NlhibkgyVTZZMVRtXzFJMjFRbk9JTVROdWVnR0w1ai1TVEYyMXFzRkhJY3AzakhIbklocGZndHJBaWxIVUJUSE5hTXlBMlZhYm5aaFNtcFh4S0trSWhvQ0JDQktwcTJfOGM3c2tnY2xhQXhJRG5SLU9HSFN3YVhKUQ)).

**Signal:** Cooling inflation expectations offer the ECB room to stay accommodative, but the Iran conflict threatens to reignite energy costs and derail the fragile recovery.

中国经济.zh:
A股与港股遭遇AI抛售潮，恒指创一年新低，A股单日蒸发2.9万亿。但结构性亮点仍在：中国新发行50亿欧元主权债获超额认购，电动车出口前景获机构上调，新能源业务分拆上市推进。资金面上，外资对中国信用依然乐观，但内部情绪脆弱。

- **[A股大幅回调](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE16V0lXMF9YSU4wUWE3djZXNFRsNlJ4UUZUc2UydHMtaGNJVVphbGpYS0pmaUs4X01kNUFocUNSWFNnQzBwcWhOZ3lsV0RoRWJqNU9CRGNVOUV2RnpkOGgyTzFR)**：不到两月百股翻倍后风险积聚，总市值蒸发约2.9万亿元，AI概念股领跌。
- **[恒指跌至一年低点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxNanpjaEdyaTVWUmF6cnZINnBpeGp1Y3puV0dDbXFSTkNjRUhpUDdJdGJPcFpJaUUyN3JBaENMVFJuekFLVzZGX3E0eFBWYURDQ2F3dHAzaUlteWNRWW96ODlYcVlwWnlvNmZoSmxRaFZ0TkM0SHp5WUtqQTJuS292VVczQmtWeUI4b2JHRWMwREJ0eWxNZ0xyOGJ1b3dHX2lrQTB6RDRfa0FEeFFUbmpZNUxMWmczVlF6d29HZWJremFkSV8xX0pGY1pn)**：AI卖盘拖累，阿里巴巴较历史高位腰斩，市场恐慌情绪蔓延。
- **[中国发行50亿欧元债](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5WUU51eElwY1VKaklKclEtVExfM2N3bnFTMTdadHRGMzN6VjNVU19RamtLa0pNaWQtYnNxellwc09ua2FVRE5kNFZXZ21PVUszOVRlQ2Y3aUMySjMyR1FURFl1QU1WbW91ZUxRWU5GeDU5bWdNSElYVWhET3dsZw)**：认购近5倍，显示国际投资者对中国主权信用的认可，与股市抛售形成反差。
- **[电动车出口预期上调](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358448/chinese-evs-expand-global-footprint-banks-raise-export-forecasts)**：高盛等上调中国EV出口预估，比亚迪、吉利下半年将推超150款新车，海外市场缓释国内价格战压力。
- **[港股融合风险讨论](https://news.google.)**：香港加速与内地融合，推出新股改革、国债期货、黄金产品，但市场质疑是否足以抵御资本外流。

**收束**：中国资产短期情绪悲观，但基本面（出口、融资）仍有支撑；监管层若出台稳定措施（如限制减持、鼓励回购），可能触发超跌反弹，但AI挤泡沫过程尚未结束。
中国经济.en:
Chinese and Hong Kong markets suffered sharp declines, with the Hang Seng Index hitting a one-year low and A-shares erasing nearly 2.9 trillion yuan in market cap in a single day. The selloff was led by AI and tech stocks amid global regulatory and financing concerns, while domestic headlines flagged over 100 stocks doubling in less than two months before the reversal. Meanwhile, China's record euro bond sale saw strong demand, and EV makers continue their global expansion.

- **A-share panic reversal:** After a frenzied rally where 100 stocks doubled in under two months, the market crashed, wiping out ~2.9 trillion yuan in market cap. The quick correction highlights speculative froth and trigger-happy retail investors ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE16V0lXMF9YSU4wUWE3djZXNFRsNlJ4UUZUc2UydHMtaGNJVVphbGpYS0pmaUs4X01kNUFocUNSWFNnQzBwcWhOZ3lsV0RoRWJqNU9CRGNVOUV2RnpkOGgyTzFR)).
- **Hong Kong at one-year low:** The Hang Seng Index fell 1.76% to 22,671, driven by an AI selloff. Alibaba is now down 50% from its all-time high, underscoring the depth of the tech rout ([BBN Times](https://news.google.), [XTB.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxNNGJ1TmU5OC1HZjIzUE5YQndWRDN2RFFtNndjOXlkQi1iVkFyLU02MkZhZVd0SVpobG1aX2VKR3l5ZHlnRktPZFoweVRMZFVuQTNnYkdGbmt3WDJYYlFiTFRNSUZLVGNrTEp5aVVrUU9GRUhCQkl3YzRfejlEN1plWlo5ZVRxOG1pd0NiVDh4VVVhWGZYczRkT25vU1hfMmJKNXE2alJNUGh1U2xjb090SmxSTU85WkRSVDRXcjJ3)).
- **China's euro bond oversubscribed:** China raised a record €5 billion in euro bonds, attracting nearly 5 times in investor orders, signaling strong international appetite for Chinese debt despite tensions ([China Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE5WUU51eElwY1VKaklKclEtVExfM2N3bnFTMTdadHRGMzN6VjNVU19RamtLa0pNaWQtYnNxellwc09ua2FVRE5kNFZXZ21PVUszOVRlQ2Y3aUMySjMyR1FURFl1QU1WbW91ZUxRWU5GeDU5bWdNSElYVWhET3dsZw)).
- **EV exports surge:** Banks raised export forecasts for Chinese EVs as BYD and Geely prepare to launch over 150 new models, cushioning a domestic slowdown. Meanwhile, China blacklisted U.S. rare earth miners amid trade tensions ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358477/ev-influx-us-rare-earth-miners-blacklisted-china-eu-trade-talks), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3358448/chinese-evs-expand-global-footprint-banks-raise-export-forecasts)).
- **SpaceX IPO barred for Chinese investors:** Chinese and Hong Kong investors are blocked from participating in the SpaceX IPO, reflecting tightening cross-border investment rules ([Business Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxOOXRXRFRuLUxhU21LVTY0TDZnSHJ6bTN1UGxfWVBIbEtRZjRkMzg1ZHNDU2xKRVhjSVBNVENweFdyN0RIUFlYREtuUVF6YVU1eVUzTWlsQlA0bmw5bkFuUmY2MFB5a3I1aVhlUDdjcHNVWVhITFVRU0FQeVM3Zl9sY0g1RElnanNlZzNyMTdzX0pRZFhHZkE)).

**Signal:** The A-share and Hong Kong corrections suggest the AI rally has run ahead of fundamentals; watch for further regulatory crackdowns and EV export data as key catalysts.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
社区氛围明显分化：AI及概念股遭遇恐慌性抛售后，投资者对40倍大牛股的紧急公告高度警惕；同时科技硬件（如AMD显卡测试）和基金限购收紧成为讨论热点。机构资金在某些标的（如富创精密）逆势买入，反映出局部机会。

- **[40倍大牛股紧急公告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE50cGxSakV4bDM1WnFLR1Mta0FLd3BCc2Y5bkhUeVVDeFJLNUdmZXVxMzhmcS0yZWY4RnVjc2Y3U3l5ME9fQ3V6VFE4bkxoT25Nd2hIZUlIcUpSM2czTmhhYlB3)**：社区高度关注，猜测与业绩变脸、股东减持或监管问询有关，情绪偏向谨慎。
- **[富创精密20cm涨停](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPcVhNWks1dHNudHk5emtmZW91VnI5TjlhemhyTTdnVFktdjU1bzlLNExJY0ZoRzlpTy1SdVQ2eW02bUo5UEV3MDQxbXlzMkt5eHRWVjNMRHotWWFTUlE)**：两家机构席位净买入4.02亿元，半导体设备板块逆势受追捧，体现国产替代逻辑。
- **[基金限购收紧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9xZGdKSUNnVDZJXzVWdjM0Q2ZGdVBUTl9GTDY4ZU1yVFBkOGlyOUZIdUFBV0dCdWZnQ25yOU5oWVFXN0gweFBhZGE4RlJqMkxKY1FyRVN5ajZkR2pQbGt6UXh3)**：上半年主动权益类基金业绩分化明显，绩优基金纷纷限购，显示基金经理对高位风险的主动防御。
- **[AMD FSR4.1测试](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5VVXItZDNRSVdlYy1vaWs3TWNfcnUzU1dwcjAyVC0waFUwZU1NcElldERtLXFJczd2YjNiRjdKTHo3SHhDT0tleWJxMXVmYjd1TTJ1UElEUXBxZnhwcHdwLWxn)**：外媒测试显示超分性能比3.1版慢14.5%，社区据此讨论游戏硬件迭代的边际回报。
- **[大宗商品涨跌榜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1MdGJOTEl2al9VNG51TGd5bTIzUU1zQXljeTJxLXBEVnQ4Z09Senlra0tlZ3JjRFdWbDBBR2pVU1U3YnAtXzBHbE9wQmhlcjQ5XzJNWVFTN1NFamJMUUZBT0R3)**：生意社周度榜单，能源化工品上涨（受中东局势影响），黑色系及部分化工品承压，投资者关注通胀传导。

**收束**：社区情绪从狂热转向警惕，资金从高位AI概念流向半导体设备和防御品种；后续关注限购基金重仓股动向及牛股公告细节，或预示市场风格切换。
同花顺社区动态.en:
The 同花顺 community is buzzing with retail investors reacting to the sharp A-share correction, the emergence of a 40x bull stock emergency announcement, and fund managers tightening purchase limits. Several high-profile stocks like 富创精密 hit the daily limit up, while commodity prices and AMD testing results also drew attention.

- **40倍大牛股紧急公告:** A stock that had surged 40x issued an emergency statement, likely signaling a warning or investigation, heightening retail panic ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE50cGxSakV4bDM1WnFLR1Mta0FLd3BCc2Y5bkhUeVVDeFJLNUdmZXVxMzhmcS0yZWY4RnVjc2Y3U3l5ME9fQ3V6VFE4bkxoT25Nd2hIZUlIcUpSM2czTmhhYlB3)).
- **绩优基金限购收紧:** Fund managers are capping purchases on top-performing funds after the rally, a classic sign of frothy inflows and concern over capacity ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9xZGdKSUNnVDZJXzVWdjM0Q2ZGdVBUTl9GTDY4ZU1yVFBkOGlyOUZIdUFBV0dCdWZnQ25yOU5oWVFXN0gweFBhZGE4RlJqMkxKY1FyRVN5ajZkR2pQbGt6UXh3)).
- **富创精密20cm涨停:** 富创精密 surged 20% with institutional net buying of ¥402 million, suggesting selective institutional appetite amid the selloff ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPcVhNWks1dHNudHk5emtmZW91VnI5TjlhemhyTTdnVFktdjU1bzlLNExJY0ZoRzlpTy1SdVQ2eW02bUo5UEV3MDQxbXlzMkt5eHRWVjNMRHotWWFTUlE)).
- **大宗商品价格涨跌榜:** 生意社 published the week's commodity price changes, a key reference for traders gauging inflation pressure ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE1MdGJOTEl2al9VNG51TGd5bTIzUU1zQXljeTJxLXBEVnQ4Z09Senlra0tlZ3JjRFdWbDBBR2pVU1U3YnAtXzBHbE9wQmhlcjQ5XzJNWVFTN1NFamJMUUZBT0R3)).
- **300087处罚落地:** A company with code 300087 received a penalty and said it would 'fully rectify,' a common pattern that often triggers further volatility ([同花顺](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBtZXoxNWhPajFKU01BS0RYNVVJZkI2RnpsVjAxM0xyYVFpdXNwMlA5YVNrWW9lTEFULVhCc0VVbE0yVldXaUpsd3dHRTRIUHZJTS0xVU9rdjROMGZ0dUJMcU5n)).

**Signal:** Retail sentiment is extremely volatile—between euphoria over limit-up stocks and fear of 40x bull stock warnings. The gap between institutional buying in select names and broad fund limits suggests a diverging market where stock-picking matters more than ever.

欧美.zh:
24小时内，欧美社会新闻以地缘冲突、自然灾害与政治法律事件为主导。美国对伊朗的打击打破短暂平静，德国热浪创纪录，委内瑞拉地震救援刻不容缓，博尔顿认罪、德州圣经争议等凸显内部分歧。

- [US conducts strikes on Iran](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg590wqxwpo) — 美军空袭伊朗目标，中东停火名存实亡，霍尔木兹海峡航运受威胁。
- [Venezuela earthquakes kill 920](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c39y79g7gzko) — 国际救援队抵达，但数百人仍被埋，家属绝望等待。
- [Ex-Trump adviser Bolton pleads guilty](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxqwg4nrvlo) — 政治人物安全违规的标杆判例，或影响未来情报管理。
- [Texas makes Bible stories required](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg8m2xkg84o) — 教育领域政教分离的激烈争论，预计引发法律挑战。
- [Europe's deadly heatwave](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2knzzwprgo) — 德国41.3℃打破全境纪录，多国公共活动暂停，气象部门预警持续。

收束：美伊冲突与极端气候双线挤压下，欧美社会内部治理与外部安全面临同步考验。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran conflict has escalated sharply after US strikes on Iranian missile and drone storage facilities, triggered by an attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz. Meanwhile, a catastrophic earthquake in Venezuela with 920 confirmed deaths dominates humanitarian headlines, and Europe is grappling with a record-breaking heatwave that is disrupting daily life. Other significant developments include John Bolton's guilty plea, Texas's controversial Bible mandate in schools, and progress in Israel-Lebanon talks.

- **US strikes Iran** — The US Central Command executed strikes in response to an attack on a vessel, threatening the June 17 ceasefire. Iran's IRGC said it targeted US military assets in the region. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg590wqxwpo), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2026/6/27/iran-war-live-us-strikes-iran-after-fire-on-vessel-in-strait-of-hormuz))
- **Venezuela earthquake death toll rises to 920** — International rescue teams are arriving, but hundreds remain trapped. A tragic story emerged of a mother who died saving her daughter. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c0jydyz8z6jo))
- **Europe heatwave sets German record at 41.3°C** — Public events canceled; health warnings issued for vulnerable populations. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cx2knzzwprgo))
- **Bolton pleads guilty to mishandling classified documents** — Faces up to 5 years and $2.25m fine; adds to legal woes of former Trump officials. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/czxqwg4nrvlo))
- **Texas mandates Bible stories in schools** — Religious freedom advocates decry the move as blurring church-state separation. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/ckg8m2xkg84o))

**Signal:** The US-Iran strikes and Venezuela quake dominate; expect heightened geopolitical risk and humanitarian aid demands.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块受中东冲突与地区内部政治震荡双重影响。韩国前第一夫人因影响力交易获刑7年，日本外国工人融入难题凸显，韩国开始全民无人机战训，同时两股热带气旋侵袭日本。

- [Former first lady gets 7 years](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/xxx) — 前第一夫人金某被判刑，影响韩国政治生态。
- [South Korea to train half a million 'drone warriors'](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/26/south-korea-drone-warriors-military-training) — 国防部要求全员具备无人机操作能力，应对朝鲜威胁。
- [Two tropical storms bring heavy rains](https://www.japantimes.co.jp/news/2026/06/27/national/tropical-storms-japan/) — 日本多地洪水预警，交通中断。
- [Japan needs more foreign workers, but many feel unwelcome](https://www.dw.com/en/japan-foreign-workers-welcome/a-xxx) — 劳动力缺口与排外情绪的矛盾加剧。
- [Seoul subway to ban e-scooters, large lithium batteries](https://www.koreaherald.com/article/xxx) — 7月1日起实施，安全考量引发电商与通勤族反弹。

收束：日韩在安全上加速军事现代化，但内部社会融合与公共安全问题同样紧迫，中东动荡已推升其能源进口成本。
日韩.en:
Regional tensions and market volatility are the key themes. South Korea is pushing a massive drone warfare training program for all military personnel, while Japan and South Korean stock markets hit record highs amid oil price gains linked to Iran war fragility. Weather disruptions from two tropical storms in Japan and domestic scandals (former first lady sentenced) also feature prominently.

- **South Korea to train 500,000 'drone warriors'** — Defense minister says all soldiers must use drones like a 'second personal firearm', signaling a major shift in warfare strategy. ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/26/south-korea-drone-warriors-military-training))
- **Japan and South Korea stocks hit record highs** — Oil gains on fragility of Iran ceasefire fueling investor sentiment, but profit-taking later caused a global skid. ([Google News Japan Korea Society](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBrY0NWZUE5MzdGOWpSOVFpd20tSXhhTFE3bWRpMnZjQWNzRlZyYlNKV1YtSTE5eWl3eGpaQ2VZRzdoYTZ2OUtmSVFJXzMxMVhpUWk3cHprTE55aHplOXc))
- **Two tropical storms bring heavy rain to Japan** — Disruption expected across parts of the country. ([The Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOaWloY19Rc0RWTkRrbnQ5dkZuNGx3UzVxaHBIM1FuN1FiMHhsLWZQajEyY2FkSXI1V2tnbEJTYkZPQTBiakQ4bUMtN05fR3VlS09PYkhPMENJeUxuMFh2Wnp3UDBnUC0xemhGSTVMUHRRd2hYMTFJNUdNMFdrSEtjdTJKMS1WOFk0))
- **Former first lady of South Korea sentenced to 7 years** in influence-peddling case, a major political scandal. ([The Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9qbzFJWXF1T1BPNi1JR2lIZWQycjA4N0dJZDA0YkUzdjRMRGRIYmJrUy12eXVQSHVaRFdtTjNEMmlOcGd1MnFkdS0xQkhvN203RXdlZjRlRQ))
- **Seoul subway to ban e-scooters and large lithium batteries** from July 1, citing safety concerns. ([The Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE1SNHNXSDFScW9PWmNQdmRsR1E4eXRQSHJzOGlVQUZHdVRfWUVkYW5VbVptU3l3MmIxMHpnNi03Nkw0SUpfTEZtZGZtbnh1cUtmVnRMZHdPdw))

**Signal:** South Korea's drone militarization and political scandals, combined with market sensitivity to Iran conflict, will drive regional attention.

中国.zh:
国内社会新闻聚焦就业、教育与社会治理领域，政策信号密集。教育部留学服务中心发布招聘、养老护理职业资格落地、高考季警惕虚假宣传，同时高层赴新疆调研强调高质量发展。

- [就业新机遇丨这些岗位，互联网企业需求大](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBzMTZiMmZleTRHSUFmOEpFUGFZYVlmOVZBcDNNTUhyY2V3Wl9fNVZqV25QWEpsal9KMGhTZVk5QkVHWnBhek4xeGNvSEdfU1cyNldmMmhrbGU5Vk95ZVdNN1k2ZV9LN0dLaUxBNzdfNTVyRzNTM3hlZjBxb0dEcDQ) — 互联网企业扩大招聘，数字经济岗位需求旺盛。
- [交钱直接上大学？警惕虚假宣传陷阱](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBueU81RVNqUy0xUlQ2clpEVmxiMWZ6cnFNcndseW1QaTNwSkU5SjNVUnUxdFhjWDNzT3M1WUplMGJJZjljRkVUQ3c0eGNvY3pBSVpJSklkR0x0S25seE1FMVh4VEgyWFBWTlpJ) — 教育部门提醒考生家长防范招生诈骗。
- [养老服务师职业资格落地](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBpYTNvUk1nQVJldDVid1E3UTlUekF4TUJDd1hnR3hlczQ5ZmE1WDZPbW5TSFRWaVY3UkFTQ3cteDhfV3Myc0xXZmdFSlRlTGZjdkxyemVHVTU3WDlzOWFyX1pzSFJSMDlObktGOWJTYWdXcHhHQ3QycFB0cjBaNlk) — 养老护理专业化新规，预计提升行业标准。
- [丁薛祥在新疆调研](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBwTUk4bFNfdW5TRnNZVlRBM0czLXVnamc3eWpSektxZ0Q4YXdGOTM1V1dZUzVVaDZiQ1pZdlVJdXpxVzc4bUNjdTdrX0tvcUE5SWhGSWN5MjlKNm8xTkxRVXRIMkQ5Uzk5WXBxbzdFNWgtbE5RWXBTbGRwSTVKU0U) — 强调培育新动能，体现对区域发展的政策倾斜。
- [布基纳法索宣布与法国断交](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTE82bHItOVhoZHFwZTJOTjd3aUx3ZVdNa0xaS09oZXFCdzQtTFpraW95UGltQWhkY3lfdmxZNVFOTV9RMktYVGUzV0N4V3cyZTZIem12bHY2b1VkSVAxQ2VadXBNNVRaRDdEbWZzM2Y3di1BZDJnTWtZRDd4SW55b1E) — 西非地缘格局变化，中国外交需重新平衡。

收束：国内政策侧重民生保障与产业升级，但外部环境不确定性（布基纳法索断交、中东冲突）可能影响“一带一路”布局。
中国.en:
Chinese domestic news this cycle is heavily focused on government-led employment initiatives, education reforms, and elderly care professionalization. Official media outlets highlight new job opportunities in internet companies, warning against fake university admission schemes, and promoting the 'great journey' historical narratives. No major breaking social incidents were reported from China in the last 24 hours, but the coverage reflects Beijing's priority on economic stability and talent development.

- **New employment opportunities in internet firms** — Official outlet Xinhua reports growing demand for specific digital roles, aligning with government's digital economy push. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBzMTZiMmZleTRHSUFmOEpFUGFZYVlmOVZBcDNNTUhyY2V3Wl9fNVZqV25QWEpsal9KMGhTZVk5QkVHWnBhek4xeGNvSEdfU1cyNldmMmhrbGU5Vk95ZVdNN1k2ZV9LN0dLaUxBNzdfNTVyRzNTM3hlZjBxb0dEcDQ))
- **Warning against fraudulent university admission** — Education authorities caution students about paying for guaranteed admission, highlighting ongoing crackdown on scams. ([China Education News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBueU81RVNqUy0xUlQ2clpEVmxiMWZ6cnFNcndseW1QaTNwSkU5SjNVUnUxdFhjWDNzT3M1WUplMGJJZjljRkVUQ3c0eGNvY3pBSVpJSklkR0x0S25seE1FMVh4VEgyWFBWTlpJ))
- **Elderly care service professional certification launched** — A new vocational qualification aims to standardize caregiving, responding to demographic pressures. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBpYTNvUk1nQVJldDVid1E3UTlUekF4TUJDd1hnR3hlczQ5ZmE1WDZPbW5TSFRWaVY3UkFTQ3cteDhfV3Myc0xXZmdFSlRlTGZjdkxyemVHVTU3WDlzOWFyX1pzSFJSMDlObktGOWJTYWdXcHhHQ3QycFB0cjBaNlk))
- **Historical narrative: 'Determination to establish socialist market economy'** — A series of articles commemorating the 14th Party Congress reinforces ideological messaging around economic reforms. ([CPC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE5SZTlwMjc3ZDdjNFdkdUNNdTc5LXFLNmZwdzcxTU9yMHp0R010WW5lZ1RkU0EzV2NNNXBYX1JVNzdNRDBYeFVRdzlkLWJ6QkJrcEFqOEx6TGM1RTJ2WWhIUVJVREMxNEphNjRJ))

**Signal:** Chinese society remains stable; focus on economic stimulus through employment and education, with no major social unrest reported.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区24小时内最爆炸的事件是“前员工误将300万现金当积分发放”，多位创作者自曝收款后被冻结账户，引发平台风控与责任争议。同时知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%，CEO周源转向AI商业化，社区气氛低迷。

- [前员工自曝现金当积分](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FSnVGbE12bEp5eWJGdldyNldXb25jTUNzQnByakpiMmNvUzhHNzB5aDRGNDRRbXgzckRFN05CYV9pOTE3WGFraXFDaWFDZkJPVkRKS2NVbDVaOFJkTE9MdDIzOA) — 员工操作失误致300万现金被当作积分发放，创作者账户被冻结，舆论强烈质疑平台处理方式。
- [我收到几万现金懵了](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9Ma2Ztb0VhMkJuSVAzY2VDemtaTUdicWIxQWw2c0RURU5xMENuTk1PUm9OSzNBclVyRHJDcktyR0QyS3RLX0VLdFhKLWFvOW1mV2NMSkk2WG03UndRX1paRUo4Yw) — 受害创作者发声，描述收到现金后账号被冻结的经过。
- [知乎2025年营收下滑23.6%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ) — 财报显示广告收入锐减，CEO押注AI商业化，但市场信心不足。
- [热门中概股普涨 霸王茶姬涨逾5%](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5RTzEweDR5b0s2Vlhwcl9iQ1ZvTTdxcXRXV25iNW5SV3dLZTB2UGVRbWtGTmhhb0ZES2pWdlkwTzBYU1lkN2dPdmliVUhGX01GZXJUOEZBczdhblY2ZFBLcHJ3) — 中概股大环境向好，但知乎股价并未同步受益。

收束：300万现金事件暴露知乎内部管理漏洞与创作者关系危机，叠加营收下滑，平台信任度与商业模式面临双重拷问。
知乎社区动态.en:
The dominant story is a major operational mishap at Zhihu: a former employee accidentally transferred 3 million RMB in cash as 'points' to users, triggering account freezes and widespread online discussion. The incident has gone viral, with affected users complaining about frozen accounts and delayed corrections. Separately, Zhihu's 2025 annual report showed a 23.6% revenue decline, and the CEO emphasized accelerating AI commercialization.

- **Ex-employee mistakenly sent 3 million RMB as points** — The 'cash for points' error led to recipient accounts being frozen and a wave of complaints. Multiple news outlets cover the fallout. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5FSnVGbE12bEp5eWJGdldyNldXb25jTUNzQnByakpiMmNvUzhHNzB5aDRGNDRRbXgzckRFN05CYV9pOTE3WGFraXFDaWFDZkJPVkRKS2NVbDVaOFJkTE9MdDIzOA), [Sina 2](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5GVU9KLW4wOE5GWXNMYV9vd3JQMlN1ZTBxcG5nWDhHTUlrUzVBbV94MThKRjc2ak16Z1dhbk91ZDlweWZ6MWhMNHBta0YycDVjRGYzM0t1OGxqNTBuVkx3RzFBdw))
- **Affected users speak out** — One user reported seeing 100,000+ RMB in their account before it was frozen; the incident has damaged trust. ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5ZU3paclNCTnppWTJnckI3WGNBZFVaV0tTNE1iNzJYVV9UQmZ2c2FqeGJKcG1KaGd5QzRlZXB6MWd2Z2tNZ0l6TGFTQUNialQ1Sk0wRXllTURvQWdnNlotV3pTOA))
- **Zhihu revenue down 23.6% in 2025** — CEO Zhou Yuan said the company will accelerate AI-related commercialization to reverse decline. ([Cailianshe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTE1BSGJZY202VWVwaHF6NTA3V3Z3MUZHVENZVHVIWmI4YW1BY3NRa2VpVkx0QVE2bUw5MXphSGJjQmpXa002OXN0YQ))
- **Community discussions also include stock performance** — Noted that Chinese ADRs like 'Chagee' rose over 5%, with netizens discussing market trends. ([NetEase](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5RTzEweDR5b0s2Vlhwcl9iQ1ZvTTdxcXRXV25iNW5SV3dLZTB2UGVRbWtGTmhhb0ZES2pWdlkwTzBYU1lkN2dPdmliVUhGX01GZXJUOEZBczdhblY2ZFBLcHJ3))

**Signal:** The cash-for-points scandal and falling revenues raise serious questions about Zhihu's internal controls and business model; watch for potential regulatory or user trust implications.

冲突局势.zh:
过去24小时，全球冲突热点呈现分化：中东出现两项重大外交进展与军事反击并存的矛盾局面；俄乌冲突中克里米亚局势恶化；同时俄罗斯对北约东部边境的威胁信号增强。

- **克里米亚紧急状态**：遭俄罗斯吞并的克里米亚宣布进入紧急状态并关闭海滩季节，因乌克兰持续打击。这是当地民用基础设施遭受系统性压力的明确信号。[Le Monde.fr](https://news.google.)

- **以色列-黎巴嫩破冰**：两国签署美国斡旋的框架协议，鲁比奥称之为“和平的第一步”。虽然细节未公布，但此举可能降低黎以边境敌对行动，并影响伊朗在黎巴嫩的代理网络。[Spectrum News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiogFBVV95cUxNOUlfbndDdUFkVkxGY253Qm5ON0h5OVExS1NWV05TTmRYOFZaeF9TdXZLZng4MVlOZl9KN1FNbjFqZWNsT2x2OVFiN3VyQkVRYWREVzFobVNrWFh6NW9EamhvekVjN0E1cHppZXV1UFVEXzlkRE5seVpXQ2dEeEdra2ppbnZ2Ny1RNTJ6OFpMS3FYU0lSR2NRUWw2Qy1peDFCd3c)

- **俄罗斯威胁波罗的海方向**：报告称俄罗斯可能计划对波罗的海国家和波兰采取军事行动，与土耳其74年北约角色的专题报道形成对比，凸显北约东翼安全态势。[The Defense Post](https://news.google.)

- **韩国大规模无人机部队**：韩国计划训练50万军队操作无人机，反映现代冲突中无人机角色日益重要，也是应对朝鲜威胁的针对性举措。[Militarnyi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPYzVtTURhVE8wMGs0SlVYYmRVb0pHUVhpNGFmeEZCNkZWVjlxdk9sYVBvSEMyeUFjOGJhdm41MVRGUVp3bktGSUEwc3RrN0xqbWE2NndMdFF0QzgzWnQ5Z3hyNHdlS2pMSHBaUVFsU2Z1Tnd6MC1hLW1KWkhIeHprVEh4VVdjQkJSd01obWNzYmpNU3BZZXc)

**收束判断**：中东和平窗口与军事打击并存，表明各方仍在试探底线；俄罗斯对北约侧翼的潜在行动需结合乌克兰战场局势综合评估。
冲突局势.en:
The conflict landscape is a tale of two fronts: a fragile diplomatic opening between Israel and Lebanon contrasts with escalating violence around Ukraine and rising tensions with Iran. Meanwhile, Russia is reportedly planning military action against Baltic states, and South Korea is investing heavily in drone warfare.

- **Crimea Emergency:** Russia-annexed Crimea declared a state of emergency amid Ukrainian strikes, closing the beach season ([Le Monde.fr](https://news.google.)).
- **Israel-Lebanon Framework:** A US-brokered deal signed by Israel and Lebanon is hailed as a first step toward peace, marking a rare diplomatic success in the region ([الحرة](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiQkFVX3lxTE5nWm9RbldNZXNyU1NZWjVIMkxKR1Z2Vi1WQ0V5eGM3b3VQOEJMMlJyam5ZWVJpcFdidlJkVW1uV2w3Zw)).
- **Russia Threatens Baltic States:** A report indicates Russia may be planning military action against Baltic states and Poland, raising alarm for NATO's eastern flank ([The Defense Post](https://news.google.)).
- **South Korea's Drone Force:** Seoul plans to train 500,000 troops to operate drones, signaling a major shift in military doctrine toward unmanned systems ([Militarnyi](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilgFBVV95cUxPYzVtTURhVE8wMGs0SlVYYmRVb0pHUVhpNGFmeEZCNkZWVjlxdk9sYVBvSEMyeUFjOGJhdm41MVRGUVp3bktGSUEwc3RrN0xqbWE2NndMdFF0QzgzWnQ5Z3hyNHdlS2pMSHBaUVFsU2Z1Tnd6MC1hLW1KWkhIeHprVEh4VVdjQkJSd01obWNzYmpNU3BZZXc)).
- **Energy Security Fears:** The Iran conflict is driving a coal comeback and shifting energy investment from climate to security, as highlighted by the IEA ([IntelliNews](https://news.google.))

**Signal:** The simultaneous diplomatic progress in the Levant and military escalation near Russia and Iran suggest a world of complex, region-specific dynamics—no single trend dominates.

国际安全.zh:
美国对伊朗的军事打击成为本日最大变量，直接动摇刚刚签署的停火备忘录；同时美军加快全球部署调整，F-35项目困境暴露供应链深层问题。

- **美伊冲突再升级**：美国中央司令部于6月26日对伊朗境内导弹、无人机和雷达设施实施打击，以回应伊朗袭击霍尔木兹海峡商船。这是双方签署和平备忘录后首次交火，停火框架面临破裂风险。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed)、[Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)

- **五角大楼预算与改名**：众议院拨款委员会批准1.1万亿美元国防拨款法案，并提议将“国防部”（Department of Defense）更名为“战争部”（Department of War），象征意义重大。[Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQdk1xWi02SjJOUUhNWmNFRFAxMnVzSVFFTGxKMHM3NHdwZWdQMjdPbFZPYnRRQXN2UElEd3NBbXk0VVhHdXBWMVkzV0ZmNmY2QVl0dEwwMFlHMkl1UWQyM1UzdmZLR2RiNk5xY0NXX25sb1kxNUJ0OC1Vdm1HU29rODhsNk43R3FLS0RWRmxGZm1DNmluOHoyZDlVVFNlV2M)

- **F-35无雷达交付**：由于AN/APG-85雷达延迟，F-35正式进入无雷达交付阶段。此举可能影响战机初始作战能力，并加剧项目成本超支。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/its-official-f-35s-are-now-being-delivered-without-radars)

- **加拿大加入GCAP战斗机计划**：加拿大考虑加入英意日第六代战斗机计划，作为拓宽防务伙伴关系的一部分。此举可能对美国传统军工出口形成制衡。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/canada-throws-a-curveball-as-it-signals-interest-in-joining-gcap-sixth-gen-fighter-program)

- **委内瑞拉地震救援**：美军C-17和两艘军舰（福特·劳德代尔堡号、比林斯号）前往委内瑞拉执行人道主义救援，展示军事外交弹性。[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/c-17-globemaster-iii-jets-flowing-to-caribbean-for-venezuela-earthquake-relief-effort)

**收束判断**：美伊冲突走向决定中东油市和全球安全态势；F-35雷达问题若持续，或推动盟国加速寻求替代方案。
国际安全.en:
The US-Iran ceasefire effectively collapsed as the US struck Iranian military sites in response to a commercial vessel attack in the Strait of Hormuz. Other developments include the US Army's push for AI-enabled drone layers, Canada's interest in the GCAP sixth-gen fighter program, and the F-35 radar delivery crisis.

- **US Strikes Iran:** US Central Command confirmed strikes on Iranian missile, drone, and radar sites following an attack on a cargo ship in the Strait of Hormuz, marking the first US military action against Iran since the peace memorandum ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/news-features/u-s-carries-out-first-strike-on-iran-since-peace-memorandum-signed), [Defense News](https://www.defensenews.com/news/your-military/2026/06/26/us-resumes-attacks-on-iran/)). This dramatically escalates tensions.
- **Pentagon Renamed Department of War?** House appropriators approved a $1.1 trillion Pentagon funding bill that includes renaming the Department of Defense to the Department of War—a symbolic change with policy implications ([Stars and Stripes](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxQdk1xWi02SjJOUUhNWmNFRFAxMnVzSVFFTGxKMHM3NHdwZWdQMjdPbFZPYnRRQXN2UElEd3NBbXk0VVhHdXBWMVkzV0ZmNmY2QVl0dEwwMFlHMkl1UWQyM1UzdmZLR2RiNk5xY0NXX25sb1kxNUJ0OC1Vdm1HU29rODhsNk43R3FLS0RWRmxGZm1DNmluOHoyZDlVVFNlV2M)).
- **F-35s Delivered Without Radars:** It is now official that F-35s are being delivered without the new AN/APG-85 radar due to delays, highlighting ongoing program woes ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/its-official-f-35s-are-now-being-delivered-without-radars)).
- **Canada Eyes GCAP:** Canada signals interest in joining the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP) for sixth-gen fighters, diversifying away from sole reliance on US platforms ([The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/air/canada-throws-a-curveball-as-it-signals-interest-in-joining-gcap-sixth-gen-fighter-program)).
- **Army AI Drone Layer:** The US Army is building an AI-enabled 'drone contact' layer for combat, integrating autonomous systems into ground operations ([Warrior Maven](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxQQ2lBbDh2TXM4Q3lvMm1fb3RUdXI0d0ZXOEtZWmNLU0RMTmtmTGFSUXdQemFDN0pULWNtN1ZyanM4SVJsdlJ5XzdxdVNzNlhSN1lqQmNvckdWZ2lTUUUtclVOT1cxNVgySlIwZHI3dEhScmJkWTF1enNpdzNhUV9VRE13ZEcxc09MU2NlWkkza0ZEN1U0TFNwNHdR))

**Signal:** The US-Iran military exchange could spiral, and defense procurement is increasingly strained by both fiscal and technical challenges—watch for ripple effects on alliance trust.

海军与印太.zh:
印太海域大规模演习与装备现代化同步推进，反无人水面舰艇和反介入能力成为焦点；欧洲海军持续打击俄罗斯影子舰队。

- **RIMPAC 2026启动**：全世界最大海军演习在夏威夷开幕，30国30余艘舰艇参与。此次演习首次纳入更多无人系统，针对反介入/区域拒止环境进行演练。[Marine Insight](https://news.google.)

- **法国扣押第5艘俄影子油轮**：法国海军在地中海拦截并扣押了MT Deliver号，这是法国第五次此类行动。欧盟对俄石油价格上限执行力度持续加强。[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)

- **美国海军提前接收两艘现代化驱逐舰**：钟云号（DDG-93）和詹姆斯·E·威廉姆斯号（DDG-95）完成升级后提前交付，显示新采办模式（PAE Maritime）的效率提升。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-navy-accepts-two-modernized-destroyers-ahead-of-schedule/)

- **韩华发布无人水面舰艇**：在巴黎Eurosatory展会上，韩华系统推出Striker MUSV，这是一种中型无人水面舰艇，可搭载导弹武器，标志着无人平台从侦察向打击转型。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/hanwha-unveils-striker-musv-family-at-eurosatory-2026/)

- **法国海军交付第4艘梭鱼级核潜艇**：德格拉塞号（S636）正式交付，法国水下核打击能力进一步增强。[Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/naval-group-delivers-4th-barracuda-type-submarine/)

**收束判断**：印太海上力量竞争白热化，无人化与反介入能力是未来博弈关键；欧洲对俄能源制裁的执行决心在海军层面得到体现。
海军与印太.en:
Naval activity is intense across the globe: RIMPAC 2026 brings 30 nations together in Hawaii, the US deploys amphibious assets for Venezuela earthquake relief, France continues its crackdown on Russian shadow fleet tankers, and Ukraine unveils a massive new underwater drone.

- **RIMPAC 2026:** The world's largest maritime exercise began with 30 nations and 30+ warships off Hawaii, demonstrating allied interoperability in the Pacific ([Marine Insight](https://news.google.)).
- **Venezuela Relief:** USS Fort Lauderdale and USS Billings are headed to Venezuela to support earthquake relief, alongside Air Force cargo aircraft ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/amphib-uss-fort-lauderdale-lcs-uss-billings-headed-to-venezuela)).
- **French Shadow Fleet Seizure:** France intercepted its fifth Russian shadow fleet tanker, MT Deliver, off Sicily, upholding sanctions enforcement ([USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/26/french-seizes-5th-russian-shadow-fleet-tanker)).
- **Ukraine's XLUUV:** Global Mark unveiled the Sea Trident ST-1000, a massive underwater strike drone, at Eurosatory 2026 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/video-ukraines-massive-new-underwater-drone-sea-trident-st-1000/)).
- **US Navy Accepts Two Modernized Destroyers:** USS Chung-Hoon and USS James E. Williams were delivered ahead of schedule under a new accelerated acquisition process ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/u-s-navy-accepts-two-modernized-destroyers-ahead-of-schedule/))

**Signal:** The convergence of humanitarian missions, major exercises, and anti-sanctions patrols underscores the US Navy's global reach, while new drone technology promises to reshape undersea warfare.

中国军情.zh:
中国在南海和太平洋的活动持续引发周边国家及美国警惕，台湾议题演习与外交表态交织；国防部就日本“再军事化”展开舆论反击。

- **台湾海上威慑桌推**：台湾针对中国大陆海上胁迫行为进行桌面推演，反映台海局势紧张升级，美台军事协调深化。[美国之音](https://news.google.)

- **新西兰警告中国军事常态化**：新西兰内部文件披露中国在太平洋地区的军事活动正在“常态化”，惠灵顿对此公开表达关切。这可能推动太平洋岛国加强与美国的安全合作。[dw.com](https://news.google.)

- **南海权益展示**：中国媒体高调报道南海“蓝洞”科考成果，强调维护权益能力。此举旨在展示存在感，同时回应域外国家指责。[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNMXZHelVSaWRpYTRWbkpLZEE2dEFPYi1lWnFBbHYyUEkydHpkMXo1U2J5dVB4RFRrRmg4MlBIUEp4ZFhDX3h5TG5ONl9jaEVaRTkxRWZSSHllQ3E3ZHBlTy1iTndyaHRSOUxpVVlLZXFmQnNhcHgyc1h1SGthbUlFV1JqTDlIQlNEMVI2UDNQWFZTVzg0ZGdWZ3hMR2xmM1pXWDFFSl84U25CWlpBTXNPNjZR)

- **五角大楼“中国军事企业清单”扩大**：美国国防部更新清单至188家中国企业，专家批评此举为“滥杀无辜”，可能进一步恶化中美经贸关系。[凤凰网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE5JdGtxYmNOQTh3MWdGZDlfeFcwR0d4dDlOXzdfdU0teUlTNDRxVEkxb3puRkNuTV92THVSbl80cG93Nl9td1hVWENudWg)

- **国防部回应日本抹黑**：中国国防部驳斥日方以“阴谋论”抹黑中国国防开支，同时反指日本加速“再军事化”。双方舆论战升温。[习近平外交思想和新时代中国外交](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1yUTNUSS1jLWxpTlVoTUFDYVRiTUlyNDJzV1gtWXlMSVZRUTJubHhDZzRWZHE2M1VLV1dUeDdEX21Tb0pWUmljdEV2a0FZNzBGcDZxTUMzZVVJWUVtR2IzdFlZcEJEMFg0a2VHa0laOE1iaHZWTlE)

**收束判断**：中国在太平洋的军事存在正从偶发性行动转向常态化部署，这将引发美国及其盟友更系统的反制措施；台海桌面推演表明双方都在为冲突升级预案做准备。
中国军情.en:
China's military posture continues to draw international attention, with Taiwan conducting tabletop exercises against Chinese maritime coercion, New Zealand warning of normalized Chinese military activities in the Pacific, and the Pentagon expanding its list of Chinese military-linked companies to 188. Meanwhile, China's defense ministry rebuts Japanese accusations over defense spending.

- **Taiwan Tabletop Exercise:** Taiwan held a tabletop exercise simulating response to Chinese maritime coercion, highlighting cross-strait readiness ([美国之音](https://news.google.)).
- **New Zealand Warns on China:** Internal documents reveal New Zealand's assessment that Chinese military activities in the Pacific are becoming 'normalized,' a phrase that signals growing alarm over Beijing's reach ([RFI](https://news.google.)).
- **Pentagon's Chinese Military List:** The US Department of Defense expanded its 'Chinese military company' list to 188 firms—critics call it 'indiscriminate killing' ([凤凰网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTE5JdGtxYmNOQTh3MWdGZDlfeFcwR0d4dDlOXzdfdU0teUlTNDRxVEkxb3puRkNuTV92THVSbl80cG93Nl9td1hVWENudWg)).
- **Japan Re-militarization Debate:** China's defense ministry accused Japan of using 'conspiracy theories' to smear China's defense spending while disguising Japan's own re-militarization ([习近平外交思想和新时代中国外交](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE1yUTNUSS1jLWxpTlVoTUFDYVRiTUlyNDJzV1gtWXlMSVZRUTJubHhDZzRWZHE2M1VLV1dUeDdEX21Tb0pWUmljdEV2a0FZNzBGcDZxTUMzZVVJWUVtR2IzdFlZcEJEMFg0a2VHa0laOE1iaHZWTlE)).
- **South China Sea Science:** China publicized a blue hole discovery to highlight its scientific research in the South China Sea, framing it as a peaceful exercise that reinforces its sovereignty claims ([新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxNMXZHelVSaWRpYTRWbkpLZEE2dEFPYi1lWnFBbHYyUEkydHpkMXo1U2J5dVB4RFRrRmg4MlBIUEp4ZFhDX3h5TG5ONl9jaEVaRTkxRWZSSHllQ3E3ZHBlTy1iTndyaHRSOUxpVVlLZXFmQnNhcHgyc1h1SGthbUlFV1JqTDlIQlNEMVI2UDNQWFZTVzg0ZGdWZ3hMR2xmM1pXWDFFSl84U25CWlpBTXNPNjZR))

**Signal:** China is simultaneously pushing back against foreign criticism while asserting its presence in the Pacific and South China Sea—expect the gap in narratives to widen as both sides frame their actions as defensive.

科技产品.zh: Prime Day进入最后一天，科技产品折扣密度达到峰值。苹果成为重头戏：Apple Watch Series 11创历史新低，AirPods Pro 3降至179美元，iPad和Mac也有罕见优惠（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/best-prime-day-apple-deals-06-26-2026/)）。Philips Hue智能灯具系列迎来罕见大促（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/957269/philips-hue-amazon-prime-day-2026-deal-sale)）。扫地机器人、Govee台灯等品类同样有深度折扣。值得关注的是，Verge编辑在覆盖36小时后只买了一副「Vampliers」钳子，折射出促销季的消费心理疲劳（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/958179/prime-day-what-i-bought-vampliers-stripped-screw-extractor)）。收束：最后一搏建议优先抢购苹果和智能家居刚需品，折扣库存正快速售罄。
科技产品.en:
Prime Day 2026 concludes today, with deep discounts on Apple hardware, smart home devices, and robot vacuums. The Verge and Wired have published extensive last-minute deal roundups, while a notable non-deal story involves YC-backed insurance startup Corgi denying allegations of stealing open-source code from Papermark—a controversy that raises questions about 'vibe coding'.

- The last day of Prime Day: Apple Watch Series 11 at its best price, AirPods Pro 3 for $179 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/949350/amazon-prime-day-sale-best-apple-deals-2026)).
- Philips Hue smart lights see rare discounts across starter kits and accessories ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/957269/philips-hue-amazon-prime-day-2026-deal-sale)).
- Govee smart lamps hit lowest-ever prices, with the Table Lamp 2 at $53.99 ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/958313/govee-table-lamp-2-classic-floor-uplighter-prime-day-2026-deal-sale)).
- Prime Day vacuum deals up to 42% off on Shark, Dyson, and Bissell ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/prime-day-vacuum-deals-06-26-2026/)).
- Corgi (YC-backed) denies stealing open-source software from Papermark; story highlights risks in startup code reuse ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/corgi-the-buzzy-y-combinator-backed-insurance-tech-startup-says-it-didnt-steal-an-open-source-product/)).

**Watch for:** Post-Prime Day price recovery and whether the Corgi-Papermark dispute leads to formal legal action.

汽车.zh: 汽车行业迎来多则关键动态：特斯拉Q2交付共识为406,024辆，仅同比增长5.7%，远低于历史增速，凸显增长瓶颈（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/tesla-q2-2026-delivery-consensus-406000/)）。Jeep Recon EV正式上市，起价67,000美元，但续航低于预期（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/jeep-recon-ev-on-sale-67000-with-limited-range/)）。Slate电动皮卡以24,950美元起售价搅局，部分地区叠加州补贴后低于2万美元，直接对标丰田Hilux EV和福特Ranger PHEV（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/slate-truck-under-20000-state-incentives/)）。通用汽车计划在2028年底推出新一代EV平台，首先用于雪佛兰Equinox EV（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/gm-plans-new-ev-platform-debut-next-gen-chevy-equinox/)）。收束：价格下探和续航焦虑仍是电动化普及的核心矛盾，Slate的激进定价可能迫使传统车企加速降本。
汽车.en:
The EV news cycle is busy: Slate Auto's $25,000 electric truck could undercut competitors with state incentives, while Tesla's Q2 delivery consensus shows only 5.7% growth. GM's new EV platform is coming in 2028, and BYD's pickup prototype appears in China with a refreshed design.

- Slate's electric truck starts at $24,950; with state rebates it could fall below $20,000 depending on location ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/slate-truck-under-20000-state-incentives/)).
- Tesla (TSLA) Q2 2026 delivery consensus: 406,024 vehicles, up 5.7% YoY, as FSD crash lawsuit settled ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/tesla-settles-fsd-crash-lawsuit-as-federal-investigations-continue/)).
- GM's next-gen EV platform to debut in 2028 with Chevy Equinox EV first ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/gm-plans-new-ev-platform-debut-next-gen-chevy-equinox/)).
- BYD's plug-in hybrid pickup spotted in China with a different look; already a hit overseas ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/byds-pickup-spotted-china-different-look/)).
- Hyundai launches Inster Lounge, a more luxurious small electric SUV for Europe ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/26/hyundais-small-electric-suv-more-upscale/)).

**Watch for:** Tesla's actual Q2 delivery report (early July) and whether Slate can scale production for global markets.

AI.zh: AI领域上演「管制与突破」双重戏码。特朗普政府解禁Anthropic的Mythos 5，允许超过100家美国企业与机构使用，但公众版Fable 5仍未开放（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/958458/anthropic-mythos-5-is-back-trump-negotiations)）。与此同时，OpenAI和Anthropic被曝在网络安全审查期间仅向特朗普批准的客户提供新模型（[Broadband Breakfast](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMixwFBVV95cUxQNkI3VnZEdkRvcUFGNjVlSjdYUWpUV2gxOHFiZVRTOXN2UVRDcmRQXzE1dkUtSEx2aXB0THV2Q3ZValJsd0JnaDhaaWdoSXNITHR3QWlWbHVZdlQ1TElUazNaMlpOZW1EYzA4R0M1NDRmYUFxU2x3dEFESVZIY2x0a3dNLTZCakxkOG9jdG1mRmxDUWdtRFA5a18zbDNILTdZU2JnQVdMcUpCS0pMbm8zUkxiR0hIR3c0UWo0MnVBaHlTRU1KZm9Z)）。中国用户则持续通过代理和伪造身份绕过Anthropic的地理限制（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/how-people-in-china-keep-outsmarting-anthropics-geolocation-restrictions/)）。OpenAI同时挖来Uber印度主管，加速印度市场布局（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/openai-poaches-uber-india-chief-to-lead-its-biggest-market-outside-the-u-s/)）。GPT-5.6开始向少量可信合作伙伴预览（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2203102/openai-starts-previewing-gpt-56-and-its-three-variants/)）。收束：模型即武器的地缘逻辑已成型，未来AI公司的市场准入将更多受政府关系左右。
AI.en:
The biggest AI story is the partial lifting of Anthropic's export ban on Mythos 5, allowing over 100 US companies and agencies access after Trump administration negotiations. OpenAI previewed GPT-5.6 in three variants and poached Uber India's chief to lead its India expansion. OpenAI also detailed its custom AI chip 'Jalapeño' built with Broadcom, part of a trend away from Nvidia dependence.

- Trump administration permits Anthropic's Mythos 5 to be used by >100 US entities; Fable 5 remains restricted ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/trump-admin-releases-anthropic-mythos-to-be-used-by-more-than-100-us-companies-agencies/), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/958458/anthropic-mythos-5-is-back-trump-negotiations)).
- OpenAI launches limited preview of GPT-5.6 with three variants (most powerful and most affordable) ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2203102/openai-starts-previewing-gpt-56-and-its-three-variants/)).
- OpenAI's custom chip 'Jalapeño' with Broadcom aims to reduce Nvidia reliance; Google, Apple, SpaceX also building in-house ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/video/why-everyone-from-openai-to-spacex-is-building-their-own-chips-and-turning-up-the-heat-on-nvidia/)).
- OpenAI hires Uber India's former chief to lead its largest non-US market ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/openai-poaches-uber-india-chief-to-lead-its-biggest-market-outside-the-u-s/)).
- Chinese users continue to bypass Anthropic's geolocation restrictions via proxies and fake identities ([Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/how-people-in-china-keep-outsmarting-anthropics-geolocation-restrictions/)).

**Watch for:** The full rollout of GPT-5.6 to broader audiences and potential antitrust scrutiny of AI chip diversification.

HackNews社区动态.zh: 社区今日最热话题是EFF对加州3D打印机监控计划的阻击，帖子获299分，108条评论，反映隐私担忧（[EFF](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/we-can-still-stop-californias-3d-printer-surveillance-scheme)）。科技界资深博主Om Malik去世引发纪念潮，Daring Fireball发文致敬（[Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/2026/06/om)）。技术层面，「open weights与闭源LLM的差距」分析帖获156分，引发对开源模型竞争力的讨论（[blog.doubleword.ai](https://blog.doubleword.ai/frontier-os-llm)）。有趣的是，一则「如何用火车站翻转牌显示Hacker News」的Show HN帖展示了一种vibe coding验证方式（[Show HN](https://popflame.quickish.space/hn-flipboard/)）。此外，Corgi（YC保险科技初创）被指控盗窃开源产品，但公司否认，引发对「vibe coding」是否导致无意识抄袭的质问（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/26/corgi-the-buzzy-y-combinator-backed-insurance-tech-startup-says-it-didnt-steal-an-open-source-product/)）。收束：社区在悼念与辩论中保持活跃，隐私、开源伦理和AI治理成为隐性主线。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News today features a mix of technical deep dives, reflections on technology history, and civic action. Highlights include a detailed postmortem of a failed nation-state attack, a tribute to Om Malik, and a community-driven effort to oppose California's 3D printer surveillance bill.

- 'Anatomy of a Failed (Nation-State?) Attack' provides a dissection of a sophisticated intrusion attempt ([grack.com](https://grack.com/blog/2026/06/25/dissecting-a-failed-nation-state-attack/)).
- A tribute to Om Malik, who passed away; discussion includes his impact on tech journalism ([Daring Fireball](https://daringfireball.net/2026/06/om), [HN thread](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=48678852)).
- Show HN: Hacker News visualized as a train station flip board, built on a vibe hosting service ([popflame.quickish.space](https://popflame.quickish.space/hn-flipboard/)).
- EFF urges public to stop California's 3D printer surveillance scheme; the proposal would require tracking of 3D printer purchases ([EFF](https://www.eff.org/deeplinks/2026/06/we-can-still-stop-californias-3d-printer-surveillance-scheme)).
- 'The gap between open weights LLMs and closed source LLMs' sparks debate (156 points, 125 comments) ([blog.doubleword.ai](https://blog.doubleword.ai/frontier-os-llm)).

**Watch for:** The outcome of California's AB 2429 – if passed, it could set a precedent for digital surveillance of manufacturing tools.

足球.zh: 世界杯小组赛尘埃落定，最后一日冷门迭出。乌拉圭门将穆斯莱拉低级失误送西班牙三分，球队遭淘汰，贝尔萨时代以“耻辱”告终（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce95d89x5meo)）。佛得角0-0逼平沙特，历史性晋级32强（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/videos/cql1v2p7949o)）。西班牙虽赢球但可能损失皮诺（[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49193963/spain-2026-world-cup-injury-yeremy-pino-nico-williams)）。梅西确认替补参加末轮（[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49191791/lionel-messi-argentina-bench-jordan-fifa-2026-world-cup)），挪威轮换哈兰德后被法国大胜。淘汰赛格局初显：西班牙若遇强敌将面临边锋短缺，而佛得角与阿根廷的对话将是“黑马vs豪门”的经典剧本。
足球.en:
World Cup group stage delivered high drama: Uruguay eliminated after a catastrophic goalkeeper error, Spain advanced with injury concerns, Cape Verde completed a fairy-tale qualification, and several teams rested stars. The knockout permutations are taking shape, with potential matchups carrying enormous strategic implications.

- **Uruguay's Nightmare:** A goalkeeping howler from Fernando Muslera handed Spain a 1-0 win and ended Uruguay's World Cup at the group stage – a humiliating exit for Marcelo Bielsa's side, now labeled 'toxic' by pundits. [Uruguay yank keeper at HT after howler vs. Spain](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49192407/uruguay-yank-keeper-muslera-howler-spain) | ['I leave nothing' - the end of 'toxic' Bielsa's Uruguay reign](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ce95d89x5meo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Cape Verde's History-Making Run:** With just 525,000 citizens, Cape Verde drew with Saudi Arabia to reach the knockout rounds in their first World Cup appearance – an emotional moment that sets up a likely meeting with Argentina. [How Cape Verde stunned World Cup to set up Argentina tie](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c0mypzl7v2xo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- **Spain's Costly Win:** Spain won Group H but may lose Yéremy Pino for the rest of the tournament, while Nico Williams is doubtful – a blow to their attacking depth ahead of the round of 32. [Spain win group but could lose Pino for rest of WC...](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49193963/spain-2026-world-cup-injury-yeremy-pino-nico-williams)
- **Strategic Rest vs. Result:** Norway left Erling Haaland on the bench in a 10-player rotation and lost heavily to France, sparking debate over squad management. Meanwhile, Argentina will rest Lionel Messi for their final group match against Jordan. [Norway coach: No Haaland vs. France a 'no-brainer'](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49190980/norway-stale-solbakken-world-cup-erling-haaland-benched-no-brainer) | [Messi to start on bench for Argentina group finale](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49191791/lionel-messi-argentina-bench-jordan-fifa-2026-world-cup)
- **Knockout Math:** Austria and Algeria have both publicly rejected the idea of losing on purpose to avoid Spain, insisting they will play to win – but the incentive to manage bracket placement remains. [Algeria, Austria, reject group math to avoid Spain...](https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/49191332/austria-algeria-fifa-world-cup-2026-win-spain-knockout)

*With the group stage concluding, the focus shifts to fixture scheduling and injury reports – the knockout rounds promise even more tension.*

篮球.zh: NBA自由市场首日即有多笔关键操作。雷霆顶薪续约哈滕施泰因（3年7500万），巩固内线（[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49193260/thunder-keep-hartenstein-new-3-year-deal-sources-say)）。太阳以3年3800万留马克·威廉姆斯，护框得到保障（[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49180880/sources-mark-williams-return-suns-3-year-38m-deal)）。重磅交易：黄蜂将拉梅洛·鲍尔送往森林狼换取纳兹·里德与选秀权（[ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49175343/hornets-trade-ball-timberwolves-reid-picks)），鲍尔与爱德华兹的组合有望成为西部新双枪。此外，活塞从雷霆得到伊赛亚·乔，补强投射。夏季联赛赛程公布，热火与雄鹿因字母哥交易成为焦点。自由市场后续仍可能有大鱼流动，湖人、勇士尚未出手。
篮球.en:
The NBA offseason is in full swing with a blockbuster trade sending LaMelo Ball to Minnesota and a wave of free-agent signings reshaping rosters. The Thunder lock up Isaiah Hartenstein, the Knicks retain José Alvarado, and the Suns keep Mark Williams, while summer league matchups are set.

- **LaMelo Ball to Minnesota:** The Hornets traded star guard LaMelo Ball and Josh Green to the Timberwolves for Naz Reid and multiple draft picks, signaling a new direction for both franchises. [Sources: Hornets' Ball to Wolves for Reid, picks](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49175343/hornets-trade-ball-timberwolves-reid-picks)
- **Hartenstein Stays in OKC:** Isaiah Hartenstein will sign a three-year, $75 million contract to remain with the Thunder, solidifying their frontcourt depth through 2028-29. [Sources: OKC to keep Hartenstein on 3-year deal](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49193260/thunder-keep-hartenstein-new-3-year-deal-sources-say)
- **Suns, Knicks Lock Up Key Pieces:** Mark Williams returns to Phoenix on a three-year, $38M deal, while José Alvarado declines his player option to sign a new three-year, $14+ million contract with the Knicks. [Sources: Williams back to Suns for 3 years, $38M](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49180880/sources-mark-williams-return-suns-3-year-38m-deal) | [Sources: Alvarado back to Knicks with new deal](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49190706/jose-alvarado-returning-new-york-knicks-new-3-year-deal)
- **Thunder Trade Isaiah Joe to Pistons:** Oklahoma City sends sharpshooter Isaiah Joe to Detroit for two second-round picks, adding to their stockpile of assets. [Sources: Pistons to land Joe in trade with OKC](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49187821/pistons-land-isaiah-joe-trade-thunder)
- **Draft Superlatives & Summer League:** AJ Dybansta and Cameron Boozer highlight the 2026 draft class's personality, while the summer league schedule features top picks and a Heat-Bucks clash after the Giannis trade. [⭐ Dybansta, Boozer top NBA draft superlatives](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49169047/nba-2026-draft-superlatives-aj-dybansta-cameron-boozer) | [Summer league features Wiz-Jazz, Heat-Bucks](https://www.espn.com/nba/story/_/id/49189165/nba-sets-summer-league-matchups-top-4-draft-picks-heat-bucks)

*As free agency continues, the ripple effects of the Ball trade and Hartenstein signing will shape the Western Conference landscape for years to come.*

虎扑社区动态.zh: 中文球迷社区焦点集中在世界杯与NBA交易。塞内加尔5-0大胜伊拉克创非洲球队单场进球纪录引发热议（[虎扑](https://news.google.)）。Opta数据显示日本有60%概率以小组第二碰巴西（[虎扑](https://news.google.)）。虎扑网友神评栏目每日更新，本期收录了关于各队表现的吐槽。胡梅尔斯现场观战德国比赛并与克洛普合影引发怀念（[虎扑](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE15NlVZLW5vZ0xXMDdXZlYwak55Tk9SanNINGVJTmU2RlRUWUY1WU54dWFQeGxKcHF2ZmdIeHVGTmpZZVFSU1BGRkVnMUd0clhSd1RTTjRR)），法国锋线豪华阵容的身价对比也成了讨论热点。
虎扑社区动态.en:
Chinese basketball and football fans on Hupu are reacting enthusiastically to World Cup breakthroughs and NBA transactions. Highlights include Senegal's record win, Japan's group-stage probabilities, France's deep squad, and community-driven draft simulations. The mood is celebratory and analytical.

- **Senegal Makes History:** A 5-0 demolition of Iraq set a new record for the largest World Cup win by an African team, sparking pride among Chinese fans following African football. [塞内加尔5-0伊拉克创非洲球队世界杯单场进球纪录](https://news.google.)
- **Japan's Group Odds Analyzed:** Opta data gives Japan a 60% chance of finishing second in Group F and facing Brazil – a matchup that would be a major test for the Samurai Blue. [Opta：日本60%概率获得F组第2碰巴西，荷兰队21%概率](https://news.google.)
- **France's Wealth of Talent:** The starting forward four for France combine for a staggering €500 million in market value, and even their substitutes are worth €310 million – a sign of incredible depth. [法国队锋线首发4人总身价5亿欧，换上4位替补身价也3.1 亿欧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMi-)
- **Community Mock Draft & Player Tracking:** Hupu has launched a live player-tracking page for the NBA draft, allowing fans to engage in mock selections and share opinions on their team's picks. [虎扑选秀大会球员追踪页面已上线，你希望你的主队能选中谁?快来玩!](https://news.google.)
- **Humorous Puns and Reactions:** Fans are enjoying a daily compilation of the best comments and memes from World Cup discussions, with a focus on player performances and managerial decisions. [世界杯今日赛程结束，虎扑网友神评集锦](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMikgFBVV95cUxNeHFFd2xsOE8zYUpRelo2eXpRVkFqbEE2NDZQc1BBMFhWbmRkNG5TMjR3dEtjd1RtSGNsWWc4Vms4cDZIVEw1aVFPZmIzRVVPU1RkV2dIby1ycWRsYU5kTXNtdWlxaVBsVldlNExaSDhLOFYwa1RzQ1JyelE1VG5wZ1hWTUhSRWpRTXJZTXV4SUd3Zw)

*The Hupu community remains a vibrant barometer of Chinese fan sentiment, mixing World Cup passion with NBA draft excitement.*

羽毛球.zh: 世界羽联公布了最新世锦赛相关新闻，但具体赛程与参赛名单尚未披露（[BWF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQZU1TYjlNYzY1clQ1c0xYbHBEdjJTRmhlOU1md1JGT3NiR3ZaeVQ5aV9VTUNOczBqLU1ZU1JSblMwMGg5c29pakU3bC0yd0xLc3hCcGh6enB5N1VKVHBOcG9ZNmpuVno5MDZRUFFiQm9Ta2dKR0hmbmlXaGtuWG1LUHNSQ2U1TzdIMEZGbUU5LUNvUWdJVlhfa21EM3ZseGRRa0Y4VjJaVkZiLXVGZ21vWXNxYnpXdUl3MmdpWHdPSWY3bHpCYk9KSE5R)）。近期国际羽坛赛事空窗期，各队正备战下半年密集赛事。值得留意的是，国羽主力陈雨菲、石宇奇等均在调整期，后续将迎战日本公开赛等。目前排行榜变动不大，但世锦赛前的热身赛将成为观察状态的关键窗口。
羽毛球.en:
Badminton coverage is minimal, with only a generic link to the BWF World Championships page. No match results, player updates, or breaking news were reported in the last 24 hours, suggesting the sport is in a lull between major events.

- **BWF World Championships – General Update:** The official BWF news feed provides no specific details, likely indicating routine scheduling or organizational announcements rather than on-court action. [News - BWF World Championships](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxQZU1TYjlNYzY1clQ1c0xYbHBEdjJTRmhlOU1md1JGT3NiR3ZaeVQ5aV9VTUNOczBqLU1ZU1JSblMwMGg5c29pakU3bC0yd0xLc3hCcGh6enB5N1VKVHBOcG9ZNmpuVno5MDZRUFFiQm9Ta2dKR0hmbmlXaGtuWG1LUHNSQ2U1TzdIMEZGbUU5LUNvUWdJVlhfa21EM3ZseGRRa0Y4VjJaVkZiLXVGZ21vWXNxYnpXdUl3MmdpWHdPSWY3bHpCYk9KSE5R)

*Badminton fans will need to wait for World Championships match reports or player interviews to emerge; the next 24 hours may bring more concrete news.*

欧美.zh: 今日欧美娱乐线头繁杂：司法与政治人物交叉上场，剧集与音乐新动态并存。Harvey Weinstein在洛杉矶上诉中虽保住了定罪，却被发回重判（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/harvey-weinstein-conviction-upheld-l-a-1236968805/)），检察官拟求刑20年，这与其纽约案走向形成微妙张力。Bill Maher与副总统JD Vance的对话（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bill-maher-played-by-jd-vance-real-time-hbo-may-vote-republican-2028-1236795870/)）不仅是政坛真人秀，更意外暴露Maher的政治摇摆性。与此同时，Luca Guadagnino因Amazon放弃发行《Artificial》而公开表达对AI的忧虑（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/luca-guadagnino-gives-hope-artificial-release-1236968824/)），业界正观望该片是否能找到下家。娱乐产业方面，《The Bear》大结局致敬已故演员Rob Reiner（[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/the-bear-series-finale-rob-reiner-tribute-1235585395/)），情怀满格；《Romy & Michele》续集正式开拍（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/mira-sorvino-marks-first-day-romy-michele-sequel-filming-1236968848/)），Mira Sorvino晒片场照引发怀旧狂潮。此外，Fox News前记者Catherine Herridge因拒绝泄密面临每日800美元罚金，已向最高法院请愿（[Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/catherine-herridge-petitions-supreme-court-halt-800-daily-fine-1236968878/)），此案牵动新闻自由红线。整体看，欧美圈正经历司法、政治与创意的多重碰撞，需要密切关注后续走向。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk is heavy with legal drama and finale nostalgia. Harvey Weinstein’s LA conviction was upheld but resentencing ordered, while Catherine Herridge takes a First Amendment fight to the Supreme Court. Television saw *The Bear*’s poignant farewell and Bill Maher’s political pivot, while Luca Guadagnino’s AI-themed film remains in limbo.

- [Harvey Weinstein’s L.A. Appeal Fails, But New Sentence Ordered For West Coast Sex Crimes Conviction](https://deadline.com/2026/06/harvey-weinstein-conviction-upheld-l-a-1236968805/) — The appeals court refused to overturn the conviction but vacated the 16-year sentence, ordering a new hearing. The Hollywood Reporter also covers the same story ([link](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/news/general-news/appeals-court-harvey-weinstein-resentencing-conviction-stands-1236632009/)).
- [‘The Bear’ Pays a Sweet and Subtle Tribute to Rob Reiner in Series Finale](https://www.rollingstone.com/tv-movies/tv-movie-news/the-bear-series-finale-rob-reiner-tribute-1235585395/) — The final episode honored the late Reiner, whose character Albert was a fan favorite.
- [Bill Maher Gets Played by JD Vance on ‘Real Time,’ Admits He May Vote Republican in 2028](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/bill-maher-played-by-jd-vance-real-time-hbo-may-vote-republican-2028-1236795870/) — The interview included Vice President Vance’s defense of Richard Nixon and escalated rhetoric on Iran, drawing sharp reactions.
- [Luca Guadagnino Gives Hope For ‘Artificial’ Release, Worries AI Is “Completely Changing” The World](https://deadline.com/2026/06/luca-guadagnino-gives-hope-artificial-release-1236968824/) — The filmmaker suggests the shelved Amazon film may find another distributor, while criticizing AI’s societal impact.
- [Reporter Catherine Herridge Petitions Supreme Court To Halt $800 Daily Fine For Not Revealing Source](https://deadline.com/2026/06/catherine-herridge-petitions-supreme-court-halt-800-daily-fine-1236968878/) — A high-stakes press freedom case that could set precedent for journalist-source privilege.

This desk’s overarching theme is that legacy entertainment figures and legal battles continue to dominate headlines, with implications for free speech and content production.

日韩.zh: 今日日韩焦点集中在品牌声誉、偶像伤亡与负面丑闻。BTS毫无意外再度登顶6月歌手品牌声誉榜（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850646wpp/june-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8)），维持着K-pop天花板的影响力。但偶像行业仍面临波折：TWS成员Youngjae因排练左大腿肌肉受伤，需调整表演动作（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850603wpp/twss-youngjae-to-modify-performances-due-to-leg-injury)）；FIFTY FIFTY的亚洲巡演临时取消印尼站、推迟马来西亚站（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850607wpp/fifty-fifty-announces-changes-to-asia-fancon-tour-including-indonesia-cancellation-and-malaysia-postponement)），运营调整引发粉丝不满。负面消息方面，知名《爱丽丝梦游边境》男演员被曝殴打女友且已向检方承认（[Google News Japan Korea Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1lVm5wV0pQazVNZHhESnNiUWtLOUEyQm5TdUZyZi1vaUJ1alRsay1RbHhPRVpQUXo1X1JhQlNDZW5ndW1reVh5Nmt0RFlZZFdOdW15ZU1iOTFGd1pZSjY4eFhQczVHTHM5YmRBbg)），此事若坐实将严重冲击其职业生涯。此外，BL类型剧集在骄傲月获得推荐（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850437wpp/5-short-but-sweet-bls-to-watch-during-a-busy-pride-month)），反映了市场对小众题材的持续包容。日韩娱乐圈在光鲜与风险之间摇摆，粉丝管理与艺人健康管理仍是两大痛点。
日韩.en:
K-pop and K-drama remain the primary drivers. BTS leads brand reputation again, while a major *Alice in Borderland* actor faces assault charges. New BL series recommendations and upcoming drama premieres provide lighter content, but tour cancellations and member injuries signal logistical challenges.

- [June Singer Brand Reputation Rankings Announced](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850646wpp/june-singer-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-8) — BTS holds the top spot for June, sustained by media coverage and community engagement.
- [Famous 'Alice in Borderland' Actor Reportedly Admits Assaulting Girlfriend, Referred to Prosecutors](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibEFVX3lxTE1lVm5wV0pQazVNZHhESnNiUWtLOUEyQm5TdUZyZi1vaUJ1alRsay1RbHhPRVpQUXo1X1JhQlNDZW5ndW1reVh5Nmt0RFlZZFdOdW15ZU1iOTFGd1pZSjY4eFhQczVHTHM5YmRBbg) — The actor, whose name is not disclosed in the feed, has been referred to prosecutors; this scandal could impact upcoming projects.
- [FIFTY FIFTY Announces Changes To Asia Fancon Tour Including Indonesia Cancellation And Malaysia Postponement](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850607wpp/fifty-fifty-announces-changes-to-asia-fancon-tour-including-indonesia-cancellation-and-malaysia-postponement) — Routing adjustments due to logistical issues; fans in affected regions face refunds or rescheduling.
- [TWS’s Youngjae To Modify Performances Due To Leg Injury](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850603wpp/twss-youngjae-to-modify-performances-due-to-leg-injury) — The rookie group member will adjust choreography after a thigh muscle injury during rehearsals.
- [Watch: CLOSE YOUR EYES, AHOF, idntt, And FLARE U Hunt For Hidden Imposters In Chaotic “IDOL SCHOOL CAMP” Teaser](https://www.soompi.com/article/1850631wpp/watch-close-your-eyes-ahof-idntt-and-flare-u-hunt-for-hidden-imposters-in-chaotic-idol-school-camp-teaser) — A new variety show blending reality game competition with idol bonding, premiering soon.

Expect continued scrutiny of the *Alice in Borderland* case and adjustments to FIFTY FIFTY’s tour as the industry navigates health and legal issues.

中国.zh: 国内影视行业在“2026中国影视之夜”与白玉兰奖两大盛事中迎来高光时刻。白兰奖揭晓（[shobserver.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1RMm95MDdhamFiSktCUHh5MXFJSjdYOVRwVU9GTjRmMHpUQ1loM2psWklhR0NBNEJZTDljTzBMTzRQdU5kSzRrTFRGaS0yU1E4bjNhX0h3NUtwUzR1dVE)）后，新浪娱乐发文剖析85花演技蜕变（[新浪网](https://news.google.)），指出行业评价正从流量转向演技，这是平台与制作方共同推动的结果。然而，韩红催票翻车事件（[新唐人電視台](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE1zR05KODZNOGtvR1ZLclNnX2Q2S2g2ZXlLV2lKLTN2OTBEVHdZZy02WVluV1hGUjhKZGY2WUczWnJmalBlaHlzUE01LWxRU21Cb0p2VW9EaVM1MXlNWGJGVNIBZkFVX3lxTE1hMUtTaGdrQ2dybV9pTnBlTDlpQmNOZ2hIOGllaVBLdVRxeThEbk1wQlBCemVpRGdVT0VaNVlvV0wyREZTamVxb3NsOTEzSlpLS1g4Y3JGVlZLUm1HSHd4SDZpZ3dGdw)）成为流量狂欢的反面教材，被指暴露了影视行业“全面熄火”的困境。同日，《TNT》MV播放量破千万（[中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTFBEck05VmEyU1Q4N3pmem1SV1RJTXV5TXBJQW42YTE2ejh1X0lXWnpDYzYwWGxlSmQ1R204Y29pQTBXRHBVN0ktRkJWQ1VDT2o4N19wNEg0a295TE0)），显示仍有新生力量突围。值得注意的是，LE SSERAFIM将重返BlizzCon闭幕演出（[中国娱乐网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE00eE1JMEdwWGV3ZzdIZzlrUGpmTi1BR3p4OVZ0VjEwbjRkcWI0aVdKcHU0MkhKUmtmLWpibWRKcGQ2RVBDT183MDdqMGFQWDQxZEF2UG9sVDFheG8)），这是K-pop与游戏产业融合的新信号。中国影视出海动作也在持续（[ent.tom.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBsQVZMdU9OVVVibmlVaGVPbjlCUDNvaVVUZmpCR0h1d09PSUNULTJqMXM4enFPNGFNeXp2U2M1aVBSSmpoeWMwTjRwX0xIVzV6RlFneA)），但“明星跨界频频翻车”（[华人头条](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5FLUZYSzQyektyaXBkckZHVXRZQWRtUEJFQkZPdGEzTEhNSHRkcGVvUENmckJvbmVxNVp2QjBLT3czQjM0WjZCR1JXNlI5ZnhOMWtYYWg3VUs2Z2pjYUE)）的反思预示着市场对专业度的要求回升。整体而言，中国影视正经历结构调整，奖杯与危机并存。
中国.en:
China’s entertainment scene is active with award ceremonies, film festivals, and cross-border collaborations. The 31st Bai Yu Lan Awards (白玉兰奖) highlighted acting evolution and industry introspection, while the 10th China-New Zealand Film Carnival opened to discuss co-production opportunities. LE SSERAFIM’s BlizzCon appearance bridges K-pop into Chinese gaming culture, and a reflective piece on the demise of idol-training shows signals regulatory and market shifts.

- [玉兰绽放临港，薪火接续荣光——第31届白玉兰奖揭晓](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1RMm95MDdhamFiSktCUHh5MXFJSjdYOVRwVU9GTjRmMHpUQ1loM2psWklhR0NBNEJZTDljTzBMTzRQdU5kSzRrTFRGaS0yU1E4bjNhX0h3NUtwUzR1dVE) — The Bai Yu Lan Awards were held in Lingang, celebrating achievements and igniting debate on “85花” actresses’ transformation.
- [第十届中国新西兰电影嘉年华开幕 共话影视合作新机遇](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQSGZiaHM4bzk2b0UtQUFLX3lzU1AxbXd4TVFOSjRNNWsya0tPOUplNlVZbHFnclluclM3d1pTdHV4VTRkUHEyXzNJQldXSTc0TVZfRUhUeDlINUo1eUZpUU5qNU9RRWNnMU9wRmFURWN6d256VHdjU3BBZU5OUS13cEZhMHZxNkRpdXZ4MQ) — The China-New Zealand Film Carnival kicked off its 10th edition, aiming to boost bilateral film collaborations.
- [LE SSERAFIM时隔三年重返BlizzCon 将担任2026暴雪嘉年华闭幕演出嘉宾](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE00eE1JMEdwWGV3ZzdIZzlrUGpmTi1BR3p4OVZ0VjEwbjRkcWI0aVdKcHU0MkhKUmtmLWpibWRKcGQ2RVBDT183MDdqMGFQWDQxZEF2UG9sVDFheG8) — The rookie girl group will headline the closing ceremony at BlizzCon 2026, marking their second appearance since 2023.
- [“投票刷流量”存在弊端！中国的“偶像养成”综艺没了，但反思仍在](https://news.google.) — A critical analysis of the post-idol-training show landscape in China, noting the end of fan-voting systems but ongoing debates about manipulation.
